prompts.text:
🧐继续探索4拼风格

📷原图→青花瓷绘 → 敦煌壁画 → 刺绣锦缎📷

#gptimage2 #prompt

请将我上传的照片制作成一张竖版拼图海报，整体采用 3:4 竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域的高度必须精确控制为整体画面高度的25%（四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差），区域之间无缝衔接，不设分隔线、不留间隙，顺序为：原图→风格1→风格2→风格3。由于每层为约3:1的极扁宽幅比例，各层主体建议横向居中排布，强调左右开阔留白与呼吸感，避免元素纵向拉伸变形或贴边拥挤。四层在人物站位、场景结构、视线方向上保持连贯呼应，呈现同一画面、四种转译的整体感。风格层（第二至四层）须遵循极简原则：每层视觉元素数量压缩至最低限度，只保留1个最核心的主体符号，其余次要装饰、背景细节与陪衬元素一律省略，画面留白占比不低于60%。

第一层保留原始照片的主体结构、人物真实互动关系与姿态、真实质感、自然光影与原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，呈现杂志摄影质感，不改变人物关系与构图逻辑，并可在不改变人物关系与构图逻辑的前提下自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，使整体更具空间感与叙事感。

第二层为青花瓷绘风格：借鉴青花瓷绘画技法，以钴蓝色线条与晕染在米白底上表现人物与场景，呈现瓷器纹样的疏朗雅致感。色彩以钴蓝与米白为主的单色系。避免蓝色浓淡层次过多显杂，避免图案化装饰堆砌。

第三层为敦煌壁画风格：借鉴敦煌壁画矿物重彩质感，表现古朴斑驳的美感，需简化线条与色块。背景为土黄或赭石底色，带斑驳壁画肌理感。色彩以赭石、石青、朱砂、土黄为主。避免裂纹肌理过多堆砌，避免复杂纹样装饰。

第四层为刺绣锦缎风格：以刺绣针脚肌理表现人物与场景轮廓，呈现丝缎光泽与针线纹理感，图案需极简概括。背景为米白或浅灰缎面底色。色彩以2至3种柔和色搭配金线点缀。避免针脚过密显繁琐，避免金线过多显浮夸。

每一层需将主体与场景统一转换为对应风格，整体表达极度克制与简化，只保留最核心的一个主体符号及其基本轮廓关系，删除一切非必要的背景元素、装饰细节与陪衬物；人物之间的关键位置关系、互动方向与姿态特征需保留，但应抽象为可识别的轮廓关系，做到“元素越少、关系越清晰”。色彩均从原图中提取归纳，每层严格控制在2-4种主色以内。四个区域的高度比例须严格保持1:1:1:1（各占25%），不可出现拼接错位或比例偏差。整体避免朋克/赛博朋克风格、写实照片质感强行叠加、卡通风格、3D渲染感、商业海报感、复杂背景堆砌、元素过多或画面拥挤、相邻两层风格雷同，以及任何文字、Logo、水印或标题。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Prompt
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is A from <Picture 1>, who becomes invisible and is revealed by flour.
<Subject 2> is B from <Picture 2>, who calmly exposes A.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, silhouettes and reference art styles. Keep equal standing heights, excluding ornaments, while preserving individual proportions.
<Audio 1> supplies the voice timbre and natural pitch range of <Subject 1> (S1). Use its vocal identity, never its recorded words. B is silent; leave any attached B voice reference unused.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second Japanese 2D anime visual comedy. A turns invisible. B tosses flour onto her, revealing a flour-covered figure. A still believes she is hidden and sneaks sideways, but B's gaze follows her. A notices her own white hand. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face. Use the selected aspect ratio.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shots 1-2): identity_preserved - original design retained through temporary invisibility and an external flour coating.
<Subject 2> (Shot 1): fully_preserved - original identity and design.
<Audio 1>: reference - A's voice for the opening sentence only.
Images define appearance and art style, not poses, backgrounds or reference-sheet layouts.
detailed_description:
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime, clean linework, cel shading, fluid character animation and expressive faces. A quiet stone courtyard at dusk. Use a dark muted background so white flour reads clearly. Exactly two characters, one A and one B. A stands screen-left and B screen-right, about one and a half meters apart on level ground at equal camera depth.
B holds one open, unmarked brown paper bag of flour in her left hand at waist height. Her right hand is free. Establish this bag in the opening frame. It stays in her left hand throughout. No additional props or readable packaging.
A's entire body, hair, costume and accessories become invisible together. She stays in place: no teleportation, copies or ghost outline.

Flour coats A's invisible surfaces, revealing her original silhouette, hair, facial contours, clothing folds and accessories in matte white. She remains flexible, never stone. Original colors do not return. Retain dark drawn eye and mouth details for readable 2D expressions. Powder moves with her body, not as a separate shell.
[Shot 1] Open on a locked medium-wide two-shot showing both characters from head to feet, their hands and the floor. Hold this uninterrupted shot through disappearance, flour reveal and sideways movements until twelve seconds. No cutaways or substitutions.

During 0.3-2.8 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1), using <Audio 1>'s voice timbre, proudly declares, [Japanese] これで、わたしはみえない! Synchronize her lips with this one sentence. Finish before three seconds. A smiles smugly and makes a small magical gesture.
Between three and four seconds, A smoothly becomes fully transparent in place. The background becomes visible through her entire silhouette. A few violet sparkles fade away. Briefly show genuinely empty-looking space where she stands: no remaining outline, visible eyes, clothes or ghost image. B calmly looks at that location.
Between four and six seconds, B scoops one generous handful of flour from the bag with her right hand and tosses it underhand toward A's established position. Show the flour traveling across the gap as a broad white fan. It hits A's invisible body, revealing her face, hair, torso, arms and clothing silhouette as the cloud settles. Residual powder falls onto her legs and the ground. Complete the reveal by six seconds.
The cloud quickly disperses, revealing the same A coated in white powder. She has not realized she is visible. She keeps a smug, sneaky expression and watches B without looking at her own body.
At six seconds, B lowers her now-empty right hand and watches A directly. Keep B's body relaxed. She does not laugh, point or speak.

Between six and eight seconds, A takes one exaggerated, quiet sidestep toward screen-left, away from B. Her whole flour-covered body moves continuously. She carefully raises and places one foot as if trying to remain undetected. B's eyes and head smoothly track her exact movement. Keep both faces readable in three-quarter view.
A pauses and notices B looking in her direction. Between eight and ten seconds, she tests this by taking one cautious step back toward screen-right, returning to her original position. B's gaze follows her back just as precisely. Pause briefly with them looking directly at each other. The joke is that A thinks she is invisible while B can plainly see her.

Between ten and twelve seconds, A slowly raises her right hand into her own line of sight, palm toward her face. Her eyes shift from B to the flour-covered fingers. She turns her wrist slightly and finally realizes that her hand is white and visible. Her smug expression disappears. B remains still, holding the bag in her left hand.

[Shot 2] At 00:12.000, cut to a frontal close-up of the SAME flour-covered A. Keep her raised white hand at the lower frame edge. Her powdered hairstyle, accessories and face remain identifiable.

A lowers her gaze from her hand and looks forward. Her eyes widen, pupils become small and eyebrows rise. Her lips part slightly once, then remain still. Use her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression. No exaggerated terror, crying, blush or speaking movements.

Make a short, controlled push-in. Hold the final full second on this silent face. A tiny sprinkle of loose flour falls from her hair while the coating stays on her face and body. End directly on A. No cut back to B, restored colors, spell reversal or extra gag.

overall_soundscape:
Exactly one spoken sentence, delivered by A in Shot 1. B never vocalizes. After three seconds, no character speech, narration, inner monologue, gasps, coughs, sneezes, grunts, screams, laughter or vocal breaths.
Use soft courtyard ambience, a brief magical shimmer for invisibility, paper-bag rustling, a soft flour puff, two light footfalls and subtle powder falling. Keep the sideways test quiet so its pauses read clearly.

non_diegetic_music:
A short mysterious instrumental build accompanies A's boast and disappearance. Stop the music as the flour lands and reveals her. No music after the reveal. No choir, vocal samples, comedy sting or canned laughter.

No subtitles, captions, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD, extra characters, duplicates, afterimages, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, costume redesign, changing body scale, stone transformation, permanent facial deformation, injury, photorealism, 3D rendering or chibi redesign.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Max Prompt

Create a 15-second Japanese 2D anime action-comedy with synchronized sound.

REFERENCES
A = character image 1 + voice audio 1: summons the gate, then freezes in shock.
B = character image 2 + voice audio 2: calmly locks the gate.
Preserve each image's exact design and style. New poses/background; never blend identities.
AUDIO — EXACT PRONUNCIATION
Exactly ONE spoken line: A confidently says 「ひらけ、じごくのもん！」 at 0.3-2.8s using audio 1's voice with accurate lip sync.
Say it once. First word: hi-ra-ke.
Audio clips define voices, not scripts. B stays silent; audio 2 generates no speech.
After 3s, ALL voices are silent, including the creature. No dialogue, narration, gasps, grunts or laughter. Sound effects continue.
STYLE / GEOGRAPHY
Hand-drawn 2D anime, cel shading, fluid motion. A left, B right in a courtyard at dusk; gate behind them. Keep screen direction.
The gate is ONE solid door in a rigid frame, hinged left, opening toward the courtyard/camera; latch on the right.
At B's waist, a small silver chain is anchored to the frame, with a sliding catch on the door. Initially unfastened.
Only A and B appear fully; show just one huge creature eye through the gap.
0-4s — SUMMONING
Low-angle wide shot. A raises her hand and speaks. Ground cracks; a massive black door rises in red light and smoke. Rumble and instrumental battle music.
Show the complete, CLOSED door. B watches calmly.

4-6.5s — LOCKING
Close-up of B's hand, chain and both fittings.
B inserts the chain's free end into the door catch and slides it locked: a tiny metallic click.
Show FIXED FRAME connected to MOVING DOOR. B releases the chain and stays beside the frame. No installation sequence.
6.5-10.5s — BLOCKED
The creature pushes outward. The door opens a few centimeters; the chain pulls taut: metallic CLANK.
Show taut chain and narrow gap together. A huge red eye peers through. A second push: another CLANK, but no wider gap.
Chain, fittings, door and frame remain intact. No creature emerging. B stays deadpan.
10.5-12s — POLITE VISITOR
Pushing, rumble and music stop. A quiet beat.
From BEHIND the door: exactly two soft, hesitant knocks, like a polite visitor.
The door stays chained and barely ajar. Nobody speaks. B does not knock.
12-15s — SILENT SHOCK
Close on A. Smile vanishes, eyes widen, pupils shrink, eyebrows lift, mouth parts slightly: her usual stunned, uncomprehending reaction.
Keep her facial design. No forced smile, sideways glance or embarrassed grimace. Mouth stays still; no speech or gasp.
Push in; hold her frozen expression for the final full second with faint ambience. End on A. No reply, extra gag or door opening.
EXCLUSIONS
No subtitles, text, logos, HUD, vocal music, comedy sting or canned laughter. No photorealism, 3D look, chibi redesign, extra people, duplicate bodies, fused hands, extra fingers or character redesign.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】
【主标题】
【核心大色域】
【结构方式】
【主色调】
【微型文化场景】
【人物动作】
【文化器物】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】

设计一张现代东方文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」为核心。

背景使用温润的暖象牙白手工纸，保留约 45%–60% 大面积留白。使用【核心大色域】建立第一视觉，根据【结构方式】形成清楚、有方法感的大形关系，可以通过纤维放射、纸面镂空、裂缝连接、正负形转换或拓印痕迹表达主题，但不要直接做成普通写实物体。

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体采用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，远看首先看到大形和色彩关系，近看才发现材料细节。

在大色域附近加入尺度很小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【人物动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做摆拍或商品陈列。

人物统一采用二维纸本淡彩插画画法：五官简洁、轻体积、完整平面色块、少量连续衣褶线，与纸张和色域属于同一个视觉世界。避免摄影真人感、3D 微缩模型、CGI 光影、强投影和真实景深。

微型场景与巨大主视觉之间建立一处真实的尺度连接，例如纤维、纸屑、裂隙、锔钉、墨迹、工具轨迹或材料本身，让“小手工动作”自然延展成“大色域结构”。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。文字不抢主视觉，不加入无意义占位词。

整体阅读顺序为：

留白与大色域 → 结构关系 → 纸纤维质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看抓眼、近看有纸感、有细节、有文化故事的东方编辑海报。

避免巨大标题、普通国风插画、写实人物、3D 微缩模型、摄影背景、PPT 网格、商业广告感、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、CGI、玻璃或镜面材质、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

prompts.text:
Prompt : Create a minimalist, elegant single-line logo/signature on a clean white canvas featuring the name "[NAME]".

Transform the capital first letter "[FIRST_LETTER]" into a stylized "[OBJECT]" while ensuring that it still clearly reads as the letter "[FIRST_LETTER]". Integrate the defining visual characteristics of the [OBJECT] naturally into the structure and strokes of the letter, rather than placing a separate object beside it.

The object-shaped first letter should flow seamlessly into the remaining letters of "[NAME]" as one continuous handwritten signature.

Keep the name clear and legible while giving it a refined, sophisticated, artistic, and personal-brand aesthetic.

Style:

minimalist single-line drawing
elegant handwritten signature
thin, smooth black ink line
monochrome black on pure white
generous negative space
graceful continuous strokes
clean premium logo aesthetic
no shadows, gradients, textures, borders, or additional text
the [FIRST_LETTER] should simultaneously look recognizable as both the letter and the [OBJECT]

The final composition should feel like one uninterrupted pen stroke, with the [OBJECT] concept subtly incorporated into the first letter and naturally transitioning into the rest of the name.

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster series built around elegant circular framing and direct interaction between the model and the circular form.

The overall style should feel like international fashion magazine covers, couture campaigns, and luxury editorial photography: refined studio lighting, realistic skin and fabric, clean backgrounds, sophisticated serif typography, controlled negative space, and strong visual hierarchy.

The circle should never feel like a simple background graphic. It must become part of the styling, pose, garment, or physical set, with the model actively sitting in it, stepping through it, wearing it, or opening it.

Keep all typography in English, with large fashion-editorial headlines and a small amount of meaningful secondary copy. Avoid logos, watermarks, numbered labels, fake magazine branding, and meaningless filler text.

For this third set, create four independent poster variations under the same visual system:

1. “PLEATED ORBIT” — a woman in a deep burgundy dress stepping through a huge blush-pink circular structure made from radial couture pleats, gently pulling one fold aside as fabric layers pass in front of and behind her body, soft and elegant but visually striking.

2. “SCARLET EXIT” — a woman in a structured black fashion look stepping out through a monumental thick scarlet-red ring, one leg still inside and the other already outside, with direct eye contact, strong movement, clean ivory background, and bold magazine-cover energy.

3. “HALO FORM” — a close-up beauty editorial of a short-haired woman in a minimal black dress wearing an oversized burnished-copper circular couture collar around her shoulders, with part of the circle open so one shoulder and hand break through the structure.

4. “ECLIPSE LOUNGE” — a young man in warm ivory and tobacco tailoring seated naturally on the inner curve of a monumental burnt-amber crescent sculpture, relaxed posture, soft cream background, warm luxury lighting, and a refined menswear editorial mood.

All four images should feel like one fashion story while using completely different relationships between the body and the circle. Keep the visuals polished, elegant, modern, and strong enough to work as magazine covers or campaign posters.

prompts.text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 30-second Japanese sword-action comedy: reference-style 2D anime characters composited into photorealistic Shibuya. Synchronized dialogue, music and effects. Use the selected aspect ratio.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1; her voice uses @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2; her voice uses @Audio 2.
All enemies use the design from @Image 3.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. Images define identity, not poses or sheet layouts. Equal heroine heights, excluding ornaments. A and B are allies; ONE of each. Replicate only enemies.
Audio references define timbre and natural pitch, not scripts. Never replay recorded words or swap voices. Enemies are silent.
STYLE AND LOCATION
A, B and enemies retain their reference illustrated styles, clean lines and cel shading. Never turn them into live-action people or 3D figurines.

Photorealistic Shibuya Scramble Crossing at night after rain: diagonal zebra stripes, station frontage, curved commercial buildings, LED screens, wet asphalt and realistic glass, concrete and steel. Screens show abstract colors, no readable brands.

Integrate the illustrated characters through matching light direction, soft contact shadows, wet-road reflections and colored light on their cel shading. Keep their faces and linework sharp. Buildings, airborne debris, dust and destruction have realistic materials, weight and lighting. Sword energy remains vivid anime-style light.

Only heroes and enemies occupy the streets; no civilians or moving traffic. Establish Shibuya in the first frame before the destruction.
OPENING SPECTACLE AND CONTINUITY
Begin directly with a combined ultimate attack; no title or long setup. Both swords are already charged in the first frame.

TEN THOUSAND enemies fill the crossing and roads in deep layered ranks. A's teal slash and B's violet slash visibly merge into ONE gigantic crescent, expanding into a pressure wave that blasts enemies AND buildings outward.

Each heroine has one right-hand silver katana and a waist scabbard. Left hands may support the grip. Keep blades rigid and clear of each other.

Show contact before displacement. Enemies stay down. Close combat uses three to six attackers, preserving @Image 3. Sparks and knockdowns; no blood or exposed wounds.

SHOT 1 — COMBINED ULTIMATE ATTACK, 0–3 seconds
Low wide view across the crossing: A left, B right, side by side, facing a vast enemy formation. Their charged blades and wet road reflections glow teal and violet.
A slashes diagonally upward, B downward, in separate spaces. Energy trails cross ahead and fuse into one white-gold crescent. Bodies and blades never collide.

Around 0.1–0.8 seconds, A uses @Audio 1 and says:
「いくよ！」

Around 0.9–1.6 seconds, B uses @Audio 2 and replies:
「あわせる！」

These are the only lines; accurate lip sync. At 1.6 seconds the crescent launches the front ranks. Show merger and impact clearly.

SHOT 2 — TEN THOUSAND BLOWN AWAY, 3–8 seconds
High oblique view over the crossing and roads. Both heroines stay grounded at the origin; debris flies away from them.
The pressure front lifts successive enemy ranks and drives thousands of silhouettes backward with spinning weapons. It also strikes buildings along both roadsides, blasting them away from the heroes.

Show a traveling chain reaction, not an instant disappearance. At wave contact, windows shatter, signs tear away, and buildings rip from their foundations and fragment. Huge concrete sections and steel frames fly OUTWARD with the army. Show collapse spreading building by building, never an unrelated explosion.

Briefly slow the airborne peak, then resume speed. Illustrated enemies and photorealistic building fragments fill the sky. Keep silhouettes readable through dust.
SHOT 3 — BACK-TO-BACK GUARD, 8–11 seconds
Low medium-wide: the heroines slide back-to-back, feet grounded. The army stays down. Keep buildings ruined throughout.

A fresh @Image 3 squad enters over distant rubble; show their arrival, no respawning. The heroines exchange a glance and face them.
SHOT 4 — LOW/HIGH TEAMWORK, 11–16 seconds
Full-body lateral tracking. A advances into three attackers, ducks an incoming sword and sweeps low. Show blade contact, sparks and the attackers losing balance.

B leaps above A's crouched shoulder, clearly separated, and strikes another attacker. Show contact and its backward fall. B lands ahead as A rises.

Hold leap and landing continuously, keeping blade paths distinct.
SHOT 5 — MUTUAL PROTECTION, 16–22 seconds
Wider three-quarter view. An enemy attacks A's rear. B steps in and visibly parries above A's shoulder. A pivots beneath the clash and strikes the attacker approaching B's side.

They turn back-to-back and simultaneously slash outward into opposite sectors. A short teal-and-violet shockwave knocks down the remaining close attackers. This follow-up is smaller than the opening ultimate attack.

Dust clears. The main army remains down, the reinforcements are defeated, and ONE last enemy is standing several meters ahead. Both heroines lower their blades.

SHOT 6 — TOO POLITE TO FINISH, 22–27 seconds
Stable wide three-shot on the crossing: A left, B right, last enemy ahead. Stop the action music.

A offers the last enemy with her empty left palm, right-hand katana lowered. B returns the gesture. Both stay serious, looking at each other.
The enemy quietly lays its sword on a zebra stripe, backs away and runs out of frame. Show this continuously.

A and B turn back together and discover only the abandoned sword. Hold an awkward pause. No dialogue explains the joke.

SHOT 7 — THE FAMILIAR FACE, 27–30 seconds
Frontal close-up of anime A against a blurred photorealistic ruined Shibuya skyline. Preserve her exact face and hair. Wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows and lips slightly parted once, then held still: her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
A looks toward camera. Push in; hold the final full second, sword out of crop. No blush, crying or speech. End on A.

SOUND AND MUSIC
After the two opening lines, no dialogue, narration, grunts, gasps, screams, laughter or vocal breaths from anyone.

Instrumental drums, strings and brass drive combat. Synchronize swords, impacts, collapses and landings. Opening: huge bass impact and cascading crashes.

Cut music at Shot 6. Hear the sword, retreating steps, settling debris and wind. No choir, vocals, comedy sting or canned laughter.
No text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, hero clones, mixed identities, extra limbs, fused bodies, morphing swords, costume changes, persistent afterimages, uncontrolled camera spins, realistic human faces, 3D character redesign or chibi.

作品主题为“梦从花朵内部生长”。画面核心叙事为：一位女性从一朵层层绽放的巨大纸花中醒来，花朵像她内心重新生长出的春天，她终于学会接住自己的柔软与生命力。

主体人物为视觉年龄约25岁的东方成年女性，柔美诗意、安静治愈，带有温柔而坚定的成长感。人物拥有柔和鹅蛋脸，明亮杏眼，眼神柔和，嘴角带浅浅微笑，像刚刚看见光。面部采用精致的东方纸艺插画式塑形，五官清晰自然，不是真人摄影质感，也不过度卡通化。

人物的发型与头饰为：黑色长发自然披散，发丝与花瓣剪纸自然连接，佩戴珍珠白纸花与小型浅金枝叶发饰。头发由流动纸带、细密镂空发丝和轻盈纸张弧线构成，头饰保持精致轻盈。

人物的服装设计为：杏粉与奶油白多层纸艺礼裙，裙摆由花瓣形纸片向外舒展，胸前与袖口带有细密花枝镂空纹样。服装由多层剪纸衣片、镂空纹样、纸雕花瓣和轻薄纸艺结构组成，能够看见清晰的层叠裙摆、纸张折痕、裁切边缘和细腻纸张纹理。

梦境通过巨型盛放纸花展开。画面中出现花朵、花藤、蝴蝶、云层、发光种子、远山，所有花朵、植物、云层和装饰元素均采用统一的剪纸与立体纸雕语言。

整体剪纸结构采用花朵绽放式。人物与画面构图表现为：人物位于中央，从层层打开的巨大花芯中站起，双手轻轻扶住外层花瓣，裙摆与花瓣共同向下展开，蝴蝶从身侧向上飞起。画面具有清晰的前后纸层关系，人物位于主要视觉层，梦境意象分布在前景、中景和背景，不遮挡人物面部与身体轮廓。

整体色彩方案为：杏粉、奶油白、香槟金为主，少量雾紫点缀。不同纸层保留各自清晰纯净的颜色，色彩协调但不使用单一滤镜覆盖，画面不灰蒙、不脏黄、不整体偏色。

光线与纸张质感为：柔和暖白光从上方落下，纸雕花瓣边缘轻微发光，纸层阴影柔和，纸张带细腻纤维与轻微折痕，层次通透。不同纸层之间形成自然柔和的投影，镂空边缘具有轻微透光，能够看见真实纸张纤维、轻微折痕、手工裁切边缘和精细镂空纹样。

画面整体具有现代东方女性艺术海报、纸雕展柜、立体纸艺装置展示感，人物是第一视觉中心，梦境意象丰富但克制，构图完整，空间层次清晰。补充要求：画面整体通透清新，不要灰蒙，人物必须是第一视觉中心。

不要未成年人，不要幼态脸，不要真人摄影，不要普通动漫，不要塑料3D，不要树脂材质，不要黏土和毛毡，不要儿童手工感，不要春节窗花，不要生肖剪纸，不要单色大红剪纸，不要人物与背景材质割裂，不要缺少纸张层次，不要纸层混乱，不要暗部死黑，不要画面灰蒙，不要整体偏色，不要元素过度堆积，不要遮挡人物面部，不要手部畸形，不要多余人物，不要文字、Logo和水印。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

[Brand Name]: {BRAND NAME}  
[Descriptor]: {BUSINESS TYPE / TAGLINE}  
[Brand Type]: {e.g. bakery, hair studio, ceramic studio, bicycle workshop}  
[Brand Keywords]: {3–5 keywords}  
[Core Visual Ideas]: {people, objects, symbols, or concepts related to the brand}  
[Primary Colors]: {2–4 restrained colors}  
[Header Color]: {main header color}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a professionally art-directed Brand to Logo exploration sheet for this brand, inspired by refined Japanese independent-shop identities, boutique branding, handcrafted print graphics, editorial typography, screen printing, block printing, and thoughtful local-business design. The result should feel designed, distinctive, and concept-driven rather than generated from generic AI logo templates.

LAYOUT

Use a strict 9:16 vertical composition. The upper brand-input section must occupy exactly 30% of the total image height, while the lower logo exploration section occupies exactly 70%. Keep the dividing line fixed at 30% from the top regardless of the length of the brand name. If the name is long, reduce the font size instead of increasing the header height.

Divide the lower 70% into four equal 2×2 quadrants using only very subtle thin dashed separators. Keep all four cells equal in size, with no outer border and no A/B/C/D numbering.

TOP SECTION

Use [Header Color] as the main background, with subtle paper grain, handmade print texture, and extremely low-contrast graphic traces inspired by the brand’s visual world. These background elements should remain atmospheric and should never become a full illustration.

Show only BRAND TO LOGO, [Brand Name], and [Descriptor]. Use clean, neutral typography for this original brand input and do not turn it into a finished logo yet. Do not add slogans, paragraphs, fake addresses, dates, decorative badges, unnecessary icons, or excessive microcopy.

LOGO DIRECTION 1 — CHARACTER / PICTORIAL

Create one memorable, concrete brand image using a person, animal, product, object, or recognizable activity directly related to the business. Simplify the subject into a compact logo composition with a strong silhouette, limited detail, restrained color, and subtle handmade print texture.

The image should feel like a genuine brand character or pictorial mark rather than a complete illustration. Avoid anime styling, exaggerated cute mascots, generic stock characters, or overly detailed scenes. Integrate the image naturally with the brand name so the pictorial element and wordmark feel like one identity.

LOGO DIRECTION 2 — EMBLEM / SYMBOL

Create a compact graphic symbol by combining two or three important ideas from [Core Visual Ideas]. Use negative space, shared geometry, overlap, transformation, visual metaphor, or double meaning so the elements become one unified mark rather than several icons placed next to each other.

The design should reward a second look while remaining simple enough to work at very small sizes. Prioritize a strong silhouette, clever graphic relationships, and clear conceptual relevance to the brand.

LOGO DIRECTION 3 — CUSTOM WORDMARK

Turn the brand name itself into the primary logo. Do not place a separate generic icon beside ordinary typography. Instead, identify a few letters with strong visual potential and modify them through cuts, shared strokes, altered counters, extended curves, negative space, structural substitutions, or subtle references to the brand’s core concept.

Only modify the letters that genuinely benefit from the concept. Keep the name highly readable and avoid decorating every character. The final result should feel like a custom-drawn wordmark designed specifically for this brand, with a clear visual idea embedded directly into the typography.

LOGO DIRECTION 4 — BRAND MARK

Create a secondary identity mark appropriate to the business, such as a maker’s mark, workshop tag, studio label, shop stamp, service mark, packaging mark, mirror label, ticket, or another format that naturally belongs to the brand’s real-world context.

Keep the structure restrained, open, and highly usable. Allow subtle handmade irregularity, broken edges, missing ink, incomplete borders, or asymmetry where appropriate, but maintain generous negative space and a clear hierarchy. Avoid rigid generic circular badges, overcrowded vintage emblems, fake heritage details, and unnecessary decorative information.

STYLE & DESIGN CONTROL

Use only 1–3 colors per logo, selected from [Primary Colors]. The four directions should share the same brand world, color logic, and general print character, but they must be visibly different in design methodology. At least one of the four concepts must contain a clear pictorial or character-based image; do not make all four logos abstract, typographic, or monogram-based.

Prioritize strong silhouettes, meaningful visual relationships, custom typography, negative space, restrained color, generous breathing room, subtle print grain, controlled irregularity, and authentic small-business character. The handmade quality should feel intentional and refined rather than distressed for decoration.

Avoid generic leaves, random botanical decoration, luxury serif clichés, fake founding dates, meaningless monograms, stock-vector icons, glossy effects, gradients, metallic foil, chrome, 3D rendering, photorealistic mockups, storefront scenes, packaging mockups, and unrelated decorative elements.

The finished image should resemble a sophisticated logo exploration page from an independent branding studio, showing four genuinely different but visually related directions for the same brand.

prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Prompt
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is character A from <Picture 1>, who summons the homing spell.
<Subject 2> is character B from <Picture 2>, who redirects it with a treat.
Preserve their exact identities, faces, hair, costumes, accessories and illustrated styles. Scale their complete designs to equal standing height while retaining individual proportions.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1). Use its vocal identity and natural pitch range without replaying recorded words.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second Japanese 2D anime action-comedy. A launches a menacing, face-bearing homing orb at B. It follows B's evasive step, proving that it tracks her. B throws a bone-shaped biscuit sideways. The orb becomes delighted and chases the biscuit instead. End on A's silent, stunned face with her casting hand still raised. Use the selected output aspect ratio.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shots 1, 4): fully_preserved - retain identity and design with new actions and expressions.
<Subject 2> (Shots 1-3): fully_preserved - retain identity and design with new actions.
<Audio 1>: reference - voice timbre for A's opening sentence only.
The images define appearance and style, not source poses, backgrounds or relative character size.
detailed_description:
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime, clean linework, cel shading, fluid action and expressive faces. A broad stone courtyard in warm daylight. Two human characters of equal standing height, measured from soles to skull tops, excluding ornaments. Establish them on level ground at equal camera depth. Maintain their scale across all shots; B is never taller or larger overall.
One hovering violet magical orb, about sixty centimeters across, has two expressive eyes and one toothy mouth formed in its glowing surface. A short energy trail follows it. Its spherical body, size and color remain consistent. It never transforms into an animal or grows legs, ears or a physical tail. Its change of expression creates the joke.
One small golden-brown bone-shaped biscuit is the only treat. Keep it large enough to recognize in B's hand. It follows a continuous thrown arc and never becomes a ball or a real bone.

[Shot 1] Open on a level wide two-shot. <Subject 1> stands screen-left and <Subject 2> screen-right, eight meters apart, both fully visible and at equal depth. Leave open courtyard around B for the later throw. A raises her right hand and gathers violet light into the single orb just in front of her, directed toward B. Its narrowed eyes and toothy grin appear threatening.
From 0.3 to 2.8 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1), using the voice timbre of <Audio 1>, confidently declares, [Japanese] どこへにげても、むだだ! Her lips synchronize with the sentence and close when it ends. At about three seconds, she thrusts her raised hand forward and launches the orb. A resonant magical surge becomes a traveling whoosh. Show the orb crossing the space toward B; it does not appear instantly beside her.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a medium-wide three-quarter view of <Subject 2> and the approaching orb. B takes one clear lateral evasive step. The orb smoothly curves toward her new position, its eyes fixed on her face. Show this correction visibly in the same shot before introducing the biscuit.
As it closes to roughly two meters away, the orb brakes into a threatening hover. Its short trail diminishes and its eyes continue tracking B. It does not strike her. B remains calm, takes one bone-shaped biscuit from a costume pouch and holds it briefly beside her shoulder. The orb's gaze shifts from her face to the biscuit. Its narrowed eyes become wide and sparkling; its fierce mouth becomes an eager grin. Keep the same orb body. No barking, panting or spoken reaction.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, cut to a wider view that includes B, the hovering orb and clear empty courtyard to B's right. B makes one relaxed sideways throw, sending the biscuit several meters across the empty courtyard, away from both characters.
Show the biscuit leave her fingers before the orb moves. The orb's eyes follow the airborne biscuit. It rotates toward the new target, then abruptly accelerates after it with an eager, curved flight path. Its trail bends behind it. The threatening music stops exactly when the orb abandons B.
Track the biscuit and pursuing orb together briefly so their relationship is unmistakable. B stays planted and watches calmly. The orb never hits or passes through her. It catches the biscuit in its mouth near the far edge of the courtyard by about eleven seconds. One small dry crunch confirms the catch. No explosion or damage. The orb continues away from the characters, leaving the confrontation over.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, cut to a frontal close-up of original <Subject 1>. Her casting hand is still raised at the edge of the frame, but the spell has abandoned her command. She looks toward the direction where the orb chased the treat.
Her confident smile disappears. Her eyes widen, pupils become small and eyebrows lift. Her lips part slightly once, then remain still. Use her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression without crying, blush or exaggerated panic. A gentle, short push-in ends with a full second holding this face. Only faint courtyard ambience remains. End directly on A, without another line, another treat or a returning orb.

overall_soundscape:
Faint courtyard wind, the summoning surge, a traveling magical whoosh, one evasive footstep, subtle clothing rustle, a sharp directional whoosh as the orb chases the biscuit, and one small biscuit crunch. A speaks only the sentence in Shot 1. B and the orb are completely silent. After three seconds, no dialogue, narration, gasps, grunts, screams, laughter, barking or vocal breaths. If a second voice reference for B is attached, leave it unused.

non_diegetic_music:
Tense instrumental low strings and restrained percussion accompany the summoning and pursuit. Stop the score abruptly when the orb turns after the thrown biscuit. Leave the chase effect and crunch exposed, then faint ambience for A's final reaction. No choir, vocal samples, comedy sting or canned laughter.

No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD, additional humans, extra orbs, duplicate treats, mixed character identities, costume changes, changing character height, extra limbs, fused hands, photorealism, 3D rendering or chibi redesign.

prompts.text:
4 popular snacks of different decades visualized with GPT 2.5

Prompt: 4 images, 1:1 do this for 4 popular snacks over the decades: INPUT: $ SUBJECT 
 
// ── INFERENCE ────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
NAME            = derive_display_word($ SUBJECT) 
PORTRAIT_STYLE  = infer_caricature_style($ SUBJECT) 
FEATURES        = infer_signature_features($ SUBJECT, 3..5) 
EQUATION        = infer_signature_equation($ SUBJECT) 
DIAGRAMS        = infer_signature_diagrams($ SUBJECT, 2..4) 
SYMBOLS         = infer_symbol_set($ SUBJECT, 4..7) 
PAPER           = infer_paper_base($ SUBJECT) 
ACCENT          = infer_highlighter_hue($ SUBJECT) 
FRAME           = infer_frame_ratio(NAME) 
 
// ── TEMPORAL STAGES ──────────────────────────────────────────── 
// We render the FINAL frame. These stages describe how the poster 
// is composed so that doodles, portrait, and name resolve naturally. 
 
STAGE 0 — PAPER BASE (t = 0.00) 
  Cream or ivory paper field fills the canvas. 
  Subtle paper fiber noise appears at low opacity. 
  No ink yet, no accent, no lettering. 
 
STAGE 1 — SCATTERED SYMBOLS (t = 0.10) 
  Four to seven small decorative symbols appear scattered across the frame. 
  Symbols include sparkles, stars, plus signs, dots, arrows, asterisks. 
  Each is drawn in single-weight marker line. 
  They establish the density of the background. 
 
STAGE 2 — DIAGRAMS (t = 0.22) 
  Signature diagrams materialize in the upper-right and mid-right zones. 
  Examples: atom with orbiting electrons, black-hole grid warp, ringed planet. 
  Diagrams are clean marker line, no shading. 
  Tiny hand-labeled notes may appear beside them. 
 
STAGE 3 — PORTRAIT (t = 0.40) 
  The caricature portrait appears in the upper-left. 
  Head, hair, defining features drawn in black marker. 
  Crosshatch shading fills the hair and any beard. 
  Expression and stance are drawn to emphasize signature features. 
  No color yet; only black ink. 
 
STAGE 4 — EQUATION (t = 0.55) 
  The signature equation or motto is hand-lettered above the name. 
  It may tuck into the portrait's edge or sit just outside it. 
  Rendered in the same marker weight as the diagrams. 
 
STAGE 5 — HIGHLIGHTER SWIPE (t = 0.70) 
  A diagonal highlighter swipe appears in the lower half of the frame. 
  Angle: ±10° from horizontal. 
  Edges are dry and uneven; the swipe is slightly wider than the name. 
  Only one accent hue is used across the whole poster. 
 
STAGE 6 — NAME (t = 0.82) 
  The subject's name is hand-lettered in bold brush marker. 
  Slant: slight forward lean. 
  Position: lower half, angled slightly upward to the right. 
  Solid black, with slight marker bleed at the edges. 
  The name sits directly on top of the highlighter swipe. 
 
STAGE 7 — CORNER MARKS (t = 0.92) 
  Small quick marks appear in the lower corners. 
  Examples: compass rose, checkmark, asterisk, tiny abstract signature. 
  They anchor the composition and give it a sketchbook feel. 
 
STAGE 8 — FINAL POLISH (t = 1.00) 
  Paper grain refined at low opacity. 
  Slight ink bleed on the lettering. 
  Every element uses the same single-weight marker line. 
  Palette strictly: black ink, cream paper, one highlighter hue. 
  No logos, no watermarks, no third-party brands. 
 
// ── HARD CONSTRAINTS HELD THROUGHOUT ─────────────────────────── 
1. Name is the largest type element in the composition. 
2. Portrait reads clearly at 200px. 
3. Equation and diagrams are legible. 
4. Highlighter appears behind the name only, never elsewhere. 
5. Four to seven small decorative symbols scattered across the frame. 
6. Crosshatch shading is used only for the portrait, not for diagrams or symbols. 
7. Palette strictly: black ink, cream paper, one highlighter hue. 
8. Single-weight marker line throughout, except for crosshatch. 
9. No logos, no watermarks, no third-party brands. 
10. The poster reads as a page from a sketchbook at thumbnail scale. 
 
// ── CAMERA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
Angle      : flat frontal, straight-on 
Format     : 1:1 or 4:5 
Resolution : 8K 
Post       : subtle paper grain, slight ink bleed, no gloss 
 
Output: one 8K hand-drawn marker sketchbook poster, fully inferred from $SUBJECT.

Every shot reveals a new part of the environment, increases tension and scale, and advances one story. No repeated master angles or filler.  Preserve the giant moss-covered trunks, overhead branch, hanging roots, flooded forest, mist, black canoe, rust-orange traveler, woven hat, and amber lantern. Keep one traveler, one canoe, one lantern, one guardian. The canoe moves deeper toward the central-right mist corridor. Preserve screen direction.  The hidden guardian is a colossal ancient stag with dark wet fur, huge irregular antlers, hanging moss, natural eyes, and believable weight. Never let trees morph into it. Hide the full creature until Shot 10.  SHOT 01 | 00-02 | CURRENT 24 mm water-level lateral track. Begin on the reference already moving. The current strengthens, pulling the canoe faster beneath the giant branch. The traveler widens their stance, the robe catches air, and the lantern swings backward. Close water races past camera while distant trunks remain immense.  SHOT 02 | 02-04 | CANOPY SHUDDER 18 mm steep high angle from beside the mossy branch. The canoe looks tiny below. A vibration travels through hanging roots and ferns, releasing a curtain of droplets. Track briefly along the branch to expose the huge vertical scale.  SHOT 03 | 04-06 | ROOT PASSAGE 20 mm forward POV from inside the canoe. The boat enters dense hanging roots. The traveler parts them with one hand; wet strands scrape cloth and pass close to lens. As they clear, a darker corridor opens ahead.  SHOT 04 | 06-08 | NEAR COLLISION 28 mm true overhead. The current bends the canoe toward a giant root buttress. The traveler plants one hand against it and pushes once, pivoting the boat just enough to miss. Show tight clearance, swirling wake, and submerged roots.  SHOT 05 | 08-10 | SAVE THE FLAME 32 mm low angle from inside the stern. The canoe rocks hard. The traveler drops into a kneel, braces on the gunwale, and pulls the lantern close. The flame nearly dies, flickers, then steadies.  SHOT 06 | 10-12 | SOMETHING BELOW 16 mm underwater wide among submerged roots. The canoe passes overhead. In the distance, one colossal hoofed leg steps onto the lakebed, driving silt outward and bending underwater plants. Show only the leg. Make the canoe feel fragile above it.  SHOT 07 | 12-14 | THE SWELL 35 mm low frontal tracking shot. A broad displaced swell arrives from the mist and lifts the bow sharply. The kneeling traveler leans into it, raises the lantern, and holds balance as water strikes the hull. No capsizing.  SHOT 08 | 14-16 | ANTLERS IN THE MIST 85 mm compressed view through foreground trunks. A huge antler moves independently behind the trees. Moss trails from it and droplets fall. Slight sideways tracking proves it is moving. The rumble becomes breathing.  SHOT 09 | 16-18 | THE OFFERING 50 mm close profile at traveler eye level. Still kneeling, the traveler slowly extends the lantern beyond the bow instead of retreating. A vast shadow lowers through fog toward the light, pushing mist ahead of it. Keep the face shaded but calm. Sound narrows to breathing, flame, and water.  SHOT 10 | 18-20 | THE FOREST BOWS 24 mm epic side reveal. For the first time show the complete colossal stag standing in the flooded corridor, tiny canoe at left, guardian filling the right and upper frame. Its antlers vanish into the canopy. The stag completes one slow bow toward the lantern, stopping safely beyond the bow. It exhales, sending mist across the water. A faint amber reflection appears in one natural eye. The traveler holds the light steady. Hold through the final frames. No fade.  CAMERA Every shot must feel visually new. Use clean cuts, natural motion blur, coherent reflections, stable anatomy, believable cloth, water, and lantern physics. No orbiting, speed ramps, whip pans, duplicates, or morphing scenery.  SOUND Continuous immersive water, hull creaks, roots, droplets, canopy, cloth, and deep breathing gradually revealed as the guardian. Add restrained low bowed strings after Shot 05. Muffle sound underwater. Remove most music in Shot 09. Open into one warm chord when the stag bows. No dialogue, narration, roar, jump scare, trailer boom, or whooshes.  LOOK Cool mist, deep moss greens, charcoal water, rust fabric, localized amber lantern light, wet organic texture, atmospheric depth, subtle grain, realistic shadows. No magical particles, glowing antlers, neon eyes, buildings, extra boats, people, text, logos, or watermarks.  Emotional arc: momentum, unease, struggle, survival, unseen mass, confrontation, courage, revelation. The climax transforms fear into awe: the traveler is recognized by something ancient.

OpenAI大善人啊！这才是授人以渔！！
简直是保姆级教程，教会你怎么用image 2.5生成自己想要的图！！

OpenAI 刚刚发布了一份非常详细的 GPT Image 2.5 Prompt 指南，而且完全免费！
这份指南把图片生成和编辑时，提示词到底该怎么写，讲得非常清楚。

其中一个很重要的原则是：
先说清楚你最终想要什么，再描述画面细节。
一条完整的图片提示词，最好依次交代：最终用途、主体、构图、风格、光线、材质、文字，以及不能出现什么（负面提示词）。

如果图片里需要生成指定文字，最好直接用引号写出需要出现的完整内容，同时明确说明文字的位置、字体风格和视觉效果，并额外要求：不要生成任何多余文字、Logo 或水印。

对于image 2.5的拿手好戏，图片编辑，要想做到言出法随，不要只告诉模型“改什么”，还要明确告诉它：哪些东西绝对不能动。

比如提示词这么写：只把画面中的白色椅子改成木质椅子，保持原来的镜头角度、构图、光线、阴影、背景和其他家具完全不变。

这个思路其实很实用，模型越来越强大，再也不用像一年前用Nanobanana或者Mj，需要大段大段专业术语，但是提示词的框架还是有一定的范式，这是不会变的。

官方还特别建议，复杂图片不要一次改太多东西。
一次只修改一个变量，然后把上一张生成结果继续作为下一次编辑的输入，也就是说如果改的多，更建议用多轮修改的方式。
这样可以最大程度减少反复修改之后，人物、构图和细节越来越跑偏的问题。

如果你经常用 AI 生成图片，或者想系统学一下怎么写出更稳定、更可控的图片 Prompt，这份指南确实值得学习，并且学习门槛很低！

生成一张 9:16 东方草本茶饮文化海报。

左侧使用大面积粗黑中文标题【主标题】，字体采用方拙、厚重、略带民艺手刻感的手写美术字：宽扁结构、粗重横竖笔画、硬朗转折、局部不规则变形，墨色厚实并带轻微缺墨感。不要优雅书法、行楷、行草或现代印刷字体，让文字本身成为主要构图元素。

以【核心草本 / 果实】作为画面主体，搭配【辅助原料】，使用平面化东方淡彩草木插画表现。植物结构清晰但适度概括，低饱和色彩、简化明暗、轻水彩晕染和旧印刷感，不做写实植物摄影或精密博物绘。

主体植物背后加入【背景设计元素】，使用低饱和、低透明度的平面色块、水墨山影、巨大淡字或不规则纸本图形形成视觉层叠，让背景参与构图，而不是空白衬底。

画面中下部加入【茶器】和少量散落茶叶、花瓣、果实或干燥原料。茶器采用平面淡彩与轻微剪贴纸本质感，轮廓略松、材质简化、阴影很轻，像旧茶包装上的静物插画，而不是写实产品摄影。

右侧加入少量细小竖排中文说明【辅助文字】，作为次级信息层。穿插 1–2 枚朱砂红印章【印章文字】，印章边框略歪、残缺、缺墨、印泥浓淡不均，保持真实手工篆刻感，不要标准规整的方形图标。

整体保持“粗黑民艺字 × 草木淡彩 × 茶器静物 × 层叠底形 × 旧纸印刷”的统一视觉语言。构图丰富但不拥挤，每张可以改变植物方向、色块形状、山影层次、茶器位置和文字布局，保持系列一致但避免模板化。

新中式细线设色，别只拿来画古诗。我用它画了今天的城市：便利店、地铁站、老小区、深夜写字楼。

4 段提示词，一段对一张图，直接拿走。换题材只改“画的是现代城市的日常：”后面那一句。

① 便利店
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜街角一家亮着灯的 24 小时便利店。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出玻璃门、货架、冰柜和门口的一辆共享单车，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：屋檐与招牌用石青、石绿，店内灯光用淡藤黄，门口一个小小的外卖骑手背影用一点朱砂红。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。店的上方飘着两团传统画法的云纹，旁边一棵团状树冠的树，用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

② 地铁站台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：早高峰的地铁站台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出站台、屏蔽门、刚进站的列车车头和一排低头看手机的候车人，线条干净不抖，人物很小。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：列车车身的腰线用石青，站台立柱用石绿，候车人群里只有一个人撑着一把朱砂红的伞。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。站台上方的留白里飘着两团传统画法的云纹，仿佛屋顶不存在。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

③ 老小区阳台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：傍晚的老小区阳台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一栋六层居民楼的侧面，每层阳台上有晾衣杆、空调外机、花盆和防盗网，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：几件晾着的衣服用石青和石绿，一户窗里的灯光用淡藤黄，一只蹲在空调外机上的猫用一点朱砂红的项圈点出来。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼旁一棵团状树冠的老树，楼顶上方飘着一团传统画法的云纹，都用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

④ 深夜写字楼
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜还亮着灯的写字楼一角。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一座玻璃幕墙写字楼的上半截，一格一格的窗户排列整齐，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：幕墙的横向分隔带用石青、石绿，整栋楼只有三四格窗户用淡藤黄点亮，其中一格窗里有一个很小的伏案身影，桌上一只朱砂红的杯子。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼腰处横着一带传统画法的云纹，把楼的下半截遮住，远处一弯细细的月亮。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

规律就三条：细线勾形，颜色只给三四处，剩下全留白。

画法参考了 @MrLarus 的新中式古诗系列。

prompts.text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese action-comedy with synchronized sound. Spectacular speed, huge effects, readable collisions. B's spinning kick topples a column of giant monsters through Shibuya like dominoes while A is still charging her ultimate sword attack. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face. Use the selected aspect ratio.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1; voice = @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2; voice = @Audio 2.
All monsters use @Image 3, approximately 100 meters tall.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. Identity references only; no sheet layouts.
Exactly ONE A and ONE B, equal standing height excluding ornaments. Replicate ONLY the monster.
Heroines remain clean-lined, cel-shaded 2D anime. Monsters retain their reference style. Photorealistic Shibuya, debris and reflections; scene-matched lighting on illustrated faces.
VOICE
ONE spoken line. A uses @Audio 1 at 0.3–1.1s and says:
「いくよ！」
Natural Japanese pronunciation, accurate lip sync. Audio references define voices, not scripts; never replay recordings.
B is silent; @Audio 2 is unused.
After this line: no dialogue, narration, screams, grunts, gasps, laughter or audible character breaths. Music and effects continue.
GEOGRAPHY
Nighttime Shibuya Scramble Crossing after rain. Zebra stripes, commercial towers, neon reflections. Screens show abstract colors, no readable text. No civilians or traffic.
EIGHT giant monsters advance in ONE straight file along the avenue. All face the heroines. Half-height spacing lets each falling body hit the next.
First monster nearest the crossing; others recede behind it. Establish this immediately.
All falls travel backward along the column, AWAY from the heroines. Both heroines finish on the intact near side of the crossing. Ruins persist.
ACTION RULES
Fast travel, visible contact, a brief impact slowdown, then explosive follow-through.
A's energy is teal-white; B's is violet. Use sharp light trails, air rings, road spray, sparks and heavy debris. Keep faces and body silhouettes readable; never replace them with glowing shapes or duplicate afterimages.
A has one katana and one waist scabbard. B's katana stays sheathed; she attacks with a kick.
A charges but NEVER fires her finisher after the opening slash.
B kicks ONLY the first monster. Every later monster falls ONLY AFTER physical contact from the preceding body. Shock rings emphasize local contact; they do not topple untouched monsters.
No simultaneous group collapse, teleporting enemies or transformation into literal domino tiles. Bodies remain intact; fallen monsters stay down.
0.0–3.0s — WALL LAUNCH AND AIRBORNE SLASH
Begin mid-action. A kicks off a building facade and rockets across the crossing, teal trail behind her and concrete chips bursting from the launch point.
Low tracking reveals the monster column.
The first monster punches. A twists past its fist and delivers ONE huge teal crescent slash against its upper torso.
Show contact, sparks and a pressure ripple. The monster staggers but stays upright; the chain reaction has not begun.
A speaks the opening line in the specified window.
She lands on the near crossing, slides briefly, plants her feet and begins charging her katana. Teal light gathers around the unchanged metal blade.
B prepares to accelerate nearby.
3.0–5.0s — VIOLET DASH AND SPINNING KICK
Track B in a full-body side view.
She accelerates low along the road, violet trail and water spray behind her, then plants one foot and makes a powerful violet-assisted leap toward the first monster's chest.
Show the leap continuously.
ONE controlled spinning kick: torso rotates, one leg extends, the other stays bent.
Her heel visibly strikes the chest around 4.5s. Briefly slow this contact, preserving the foot and target outlines.
A huge violet pressure ring bursts from behind the monster's back; nearby windows shatter. Resume speed as its upper body snaps backward toward the second monster.
It falls into, not over, the column.
B rebounds toward the near crossing. Show her landing near A.
5.0–8.5s — MONSTER-TO-MONSTER COLLISIONS
Side-oblique tracking along the avenue.
The first monster initially tips backward with visible weight. Its upper back strikes the second monster's chest BEFORE the second begins falling.
A local air ring and bass impact punctuate contact. The second hits the third, then the third hits the fourth. Continue sequentially along the column.
Accelerate the pacing after the first clear collision. Track beside the chain, showing each next monster upright before contact.
Falling bodies smash empty buildings beside the road. Facades fracture, steel bends, floors break and asphalt buckles beneath each landing.
Heavy debris bursts outward. Keep body contacts visible above the dust.
Body collisions cause every successive fall.

8.5–11.0s — CITY-SCALE CHAIN REACTION
Rise into a high oblique wide view.
The remaining monsters fall in order. The last crashes down with the largest debris plume through the far buildings.
Entire column defeated; show its continuous destruction path.
Keep the two heroines as separate small silhouettes on the intact near crossing.
A's charging glow stays visible: her unused finisher still builds.
11.0–12.5s — READY TOO LATE
Stable medium two-shot: A left, B right.
A completes her charge and holds a dramatic two-handed sword stance. A towering teal aura rises from the blade, but no attack leaves it.
B calmly brushes her empty hands together once, looking satisfied.
A looks toward the defeated column; her confident expression fades.
The sword stays unchanged inside its huge luminous aura.
Stop the music. Leave the quiet charging hum and distant rubble.
12.5–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Frontal close-up of A, exact reference face and hair.
Wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows; lips part ONCE and hold still. Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
She looks toward camera. No blush, crying or scream face.
A faint teal glow from the still-unused sword lights her face.
Short push-in; hold the final full second. End on A without firing the attack or adding another gag.
SOUND
Instrumental percussion, strings and brass. No choir or vocal samples.
Synchronize every launch, slash, kick and collision.
Brief musical drop before the kick, then a sharp crack and deep bass at contact.
Separate each heavy impact from the following concrete and glass crashes.
Music stops at the final two-shot. End with wind, settling rubble and the awkwardly persistent charging hum.
No laughter, comedy sting or monster vocals.
EXCLUDE
Subtitles, captions, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD, hero clones, mixed identities, costume changes, extra limbs or fingers, fused bodies, morphing weapons, photorealistic heroine faces, 3D/chibi redesign, blood, dismemberment, injury to heroines, uncontrolled camera spins, flashes hiding contact, premature group collapse or A firing her charged finisher.

prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Prompt
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is A from <Picture 1>, who fires and sustains the beam.
<Subject 2> is B from <Picture 2>, who converts it into a rainbow and takes a selfie.
Preserve exact reference faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, colors, proportions and illustrated styles. Keep equal standing heights, excluding ornaments.
<Audio 1> supplies the voice timbre and natural pitch range of <Subject 1> (S1). Use its vocal identity, not its recorded words. B never vocalizes; leave any B voice reference unused.
summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second Japanese 2D anime action-comedy. A fires a spectacular white energy beam. B has already positioned a small triangular prism in its path. The beam enters the prism and emerges as a huge rainbow arch. B takes a selfie with the rainbow while holding the prism steady. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face as she continues powering the beam. Use the selected aspect ratio.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shots 1, 2, 4): fully_preserved - reference identity and design, new actions.
<Subject 2> (Shots 1-3): fully_preserved - reference identity and design, new actions.
<Audio 1>: reference - A's single opening sentence.
Images define appearance and style, not poses, backgrounds or reference-sheet layouts.
detailed_description:
Hand-drawn 2D anime, clean linework, cel shading, fluid movement and expressive faces. An empty stone plaza under a dark blue dusk sky. Exactly two people: A screen-left, B screen-right, eight meters apart at equal camera depth on level ground. Keep consistent scale and screen direction.
A projects ONE sustained white beam toward screen-right at chest height. A narrow brilliant core, smaller than the prism face, has an enormous turbulent luminous envelope.

B holds ONE twenty-centimeter triangular glass prism in her LEFT hand, gripping its lower edge clear of the optical faces. Extend it toward A and forward of her torso, keeping the beam clear of her body.
At the prism, the glow converges into the core. White light enters one face; seven colors emerge upward into a huge magical rainbow arch behind B. Keep the hands-to-prism-to-rainbow connection visible. No white beam passes through toward B.

B's RIGHT hand holds ONE plain smartphone. For the selfie, extend this arm toward camera with the screen facing herself. No hand switching, floating objects, readable screen or selfie-image insert.
[Shot 1] Open on a wide full-body two-shot showing the eight-meter gap. A braces her feet and brings both palms forward. A white energy sphere rapidly gathers between them, throwing sharp light onto the paving. Her hair and costume flutter in the growing pressure.
During 0.3-2.8 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1), using <Audio 1>'s voice timbre, confidently declares, [Japanese] このいちげきで、おわりだ! Synchronize her lips with this sentence and finish before three seconds. Her mouth closes into a proud smile.
B holds the phone low at her right hip and calmly positions the left-hand prism at chest height in the future beam path BEFORE A fires.
By four seconds, the attack is fully charged and the prism is ready. No moving beam has crossed the gap yet.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a stable wide three-quarter side view showing both characters, the full beam path, the prism and open sky. Keep the established left-to-right direction.
A fires. The beam crosses eight meters within a few animation frames and hits the ALREADY positioned prism. No slow projectile or reaction after launch. Show contact clearly using the sustained beam.

In this continuous shot, show the white core entering the glass. At that exact contact, seven clearly separated colored bands emerge upward: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet. The bands form one brilliant rainbow arch overhead within about one second. Its base remains visibly connected to the prism.

Stop the dramatic music as the rainbow appears. Replace the aggressive impact expectation with a delicate glass chime. No explosion, shattered glass, collision with B or rainbow appearing independently elsewhere.

Between six and eight seconds, hold A's grand attack pose, the huge beam, B's tiny prism and the rainbow together. A keeps supplying the beam with both arms extended.

B smiles at the rainbow and raises her right-hand phone. Her left arm and prism stay fixed; the beam and rainbow remain stable.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, cut to a medium three-quarter view of B, including her face, both hands, prism contact, phone and rainbow. Keep the beam below her face and preserve screen direction.

B extends her right arm for the selfie, keeping her torso still and turning only her head toward the screen. She smiles and taps the screen with her right thumb.

One quiet camera shutter click around ten seconds confirms the selfie. No flash obscuring the scene, phone-screen insert, speech or peace sign: both hands already have a job.

B admires the screen while holding the prism steady. White light continues entering and colors exit upward; offscreen A still powers the beam.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, cut to a frontal close-up of A from slightly beside the beam axis. Include her extended forearms and the white light leaving her palms at the lower frame edge. She remains in her original place, still sustaining the attack. Colored reflections softly tint her face.

A looks toward B taking the selfie. Her proud smile disappears. Her eyes widen, pupils become small and eyebrows lift. Her lips part slightly once, then remain still. Use her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression. No crying, blush, anger or exaggerated panic.

Slowly push in; hold the final full second. Arms extended, A still powers B's photo. End on her silent face without beam shutdown, retaliation or extra gag.

overall_soundscape:
Exactly one spoken sentence, by A in Shot 1. B never vocalizes. After three seconds, no dialogue, narration, gasps, screams, grunts, laughter or vocal breaths.
Use a rising magical charge, one sharp launch sound and a sustained beam hum. At prism contact, add one delicate glass chime and lower the hum enough for the selfie shutter to be clearly heard. Continue the quiet hum and faint plaza ambience through the final close-up, matching the ongoing beam.

non_diegetic_music:
Grand instrumental brass, strings and percussion build during charging and launch. Stop when the rainbow emerges. No music afterward. No choir, vocal samples, comedy sting or canned laughter.

No text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, extra characters, duplicates, extra prisms or phones, disconnected rainbow, slow-moving beam, hand switching, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, changing body scale, costume redesign, injury, photorealism, 3D rendering or chibi redesign.

prompts.text:
兄弟，我发现了一个特别容易出神图的海报公式。

真的不是再加几个“高级感、电影感、杂志感”这种废词。

我最近在研究这类复古海报，突然发现它最爽的地方是：

把一幅名画“拆了”，只拿走它最值钱的东西。

不是复刻《雾海上的漫游者》《睡莲》《神奈川冲浪里》，而是只提炼：

巨大英文单词 + 极小人物 + 大面积留白 + Swiss 排版 + 70 年代旧印刷质感。

一下就从“名画二创”变成了真正的概念设计海报。

提示词母版也直接送了，自己替换括号就行👇

3:4 conceptual retro editorial poster, inspired by 【名画母题/艺术流派】 but not directly reproducing it, reinterpret its composition, visual motif and emotional atmosphere as a modern conceptual poster.

Large 【cream / ivory】 negative space on aged uncoated paper, giant uppercase word “【主标题】” in 【颜色】 bold condensed sans-serif typography, interacting with the scene through fog, water, architecture or foreground elements.

Lower portion shows 【重新设计后的场景】 with a very small 【人物 / 小船 / 房子 / 物体】 as a scale anchor, creating a strong contrast between monumental typography and tiny human presence.

Swiss modernist editorial layout, tiny ISSUE / DATE / POSTER SERIES metadata, thin rule lines, small poetic quote, bottom caption and issue number.

Muted 2–4 color palette, 1970s European art magazine aesthetic, vintage offset printing, screen print texture, halftone grain, faded ink, subtle scratches, slight misregistration, aged paper fibers, matte finish.

minimal, poetic, conceptual, museum poster, elegant, restrained, quiet but visually striking.

no QR code, no watermark, no logo, no mockup, no social media overlay, no glossy commercial style, no neon cyberpunk, no 3D metallic text, no clutter
这套东西我越玩越觉得有意思。

AI 画图最怕的是“想画得漂亮”，一旦开始用设计逻辑控制它，味道马上就不一样了。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

[Product / Brand]: {e.g. Coca-Cola glass bottle, Starbucks cup, Nongfu Spring bottle}
[Mini World Concept]: {e.g. soda diner, coffee treehouse, mountain sanctuary, water park}
[Main Palette]: {use the product’s recognizable brand colors plus 2–3 supporting colors}
[Output Mode]: Before / after comparison
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Use the uploaded real product photo as the source.

Create one vertical 9:16 comparison image with two exactly equal sections:

Top 50%: the original product photographed naturally in a real everyday setting
Bottom 50%: the same product transformed into a hand illustrated miniature world

For the top image, keep the product realistic and recognizable. Present it like a casual smartphone photo from everyday life, not a polished studio advertisement. Use natural light, realistic reflections, slight imperfections, and a believable surrounding environment.

For the bottom image, completely redraw the product and the entire scene in a unified hand illustrated mini world style.

Do not keep the real photographic product inside the illustration.

The packaging itself must become the main architecture and structural foundation of the miniature world.

Preserve the product’s recognizable silhouette, packaging proportions, key brand colors, label placement, cap, lid, logo area, and other distinctive visual features so it remains immediately identifiable.

Reinterpret different parts of the packaging as architectural spaces such as:

rooftop terraces, balconies, cafés, shops, observation decks, stairways, windows, bridges, gardens, pools, playgrounds, or other spaces that naturally match the product and brand personality.

Build the mini world around the product’s real characteristics.

Use the flavor, ingredients, function, origin, packaging shape, brand colors, or emotional associations as design inspiration.

For example, fruit flavors may become gardens or slides, water may become waterfalls and streams, coffee may become reading terraces and cafés, and nostalgic drinks may become small neighborhood stores.

Add a few tiny people, animals, furniture, plants, and everyday activities to make the world feel alive.

Every small detail should support a clear story. Avoid random decorative objects that have no connection to the product.

Use clean hand drawn outlines, warm matte color blocks, subtle paper grain, gentle texture, and slightly imperfect handcrafted details.

The style should feel like a polished commercial picture book illustration: playful, warm, detailed, collectible, and visually rich without becoming cluttered.

Keep one clear visual hierarchy:

the product packaging is the main landmark, the miniature architecture grows from it, small characters create life and storytelling, supporting elements remain secondary.

Avoid photorealistic rendering, 3D CGI, plastic toy appearance, LEGO style, realistic miniature photography, excessive logos, random buildings, overcrowded characters, or unrelated fantasy elements.

Keep the original brand identity recognizable, but do not repeat logos or brand names excessively.

Do not add extra titles, captions, Before / After labels, borders, watermarks, or decorative typography.

The final image should make viewers immediately understand:

the same everyday product has been transformed into a complete illustrated miniature world.

上身布满精致白色小花刺绣、蕾丝与细腻纱质纹理，采用克制的半透明层叠效果，保持关键部位完整覆盖。腰部修身收束，突出纤细腰线；下半身为轻盈的浅色竖纹纱质长裙，具有自然垂坠、柔和半透明层次与真实织物褶皱，整体温婉、精致而高级。

人物身侧是一张同系列浅原木色简约餐桌，背景为大面积浅原木竖纹拼接木饰面墙，搭配少量极简日式家具与留白。空间呈现高级日式餐厅私密包间或精致原木居家空间的安静氛围，背景干净、不杂乱。

暖柔室内漫射光从人物侧前方自然落下，在脸部、乌黑长发、肩颈、锁骨、蕾丝刺绣与纱裙表面形成柔和细腻的明暗过渡。冷白肌肤保持明亮通透，原木墙面产生温暖自然的环境反射光，形成冷白肤色 × 暖米原木色的高级冷暖对比。

采用 9:16 中全景至全身坐姿构图，使用约 50–85mm 人像焦段，完整表现人物头部、真人面容、深 V 蕾丝裙、纤细腰身、坐姿与主要腿部线条。人物主体高清锐利，背景仅轻微柔化，保留木纹、桌椅和空间结构。

整体呈现暖米色、奶油白、浅原木色与冷白肤色的低饱和高级色调。蕾丝刺绣、真丝纱质、天然木纹、发丝与真实皮肤纹理清晰细腻，画面静谧、温婉、松弛、优雅，具有高级日系商业人像与时尚 Editorial 质感。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese anime action-comedy with synchronized sound. Use the selected output aspect ratio.

STORY
A charges a world-ending spell through her staff. B notices its ordinary electrical cable and unplugs it from the wall. Every magical effect instantly switches off. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1. Her voice comes only from @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2. B has no voice reference and is completely silent.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and original 2D art styles. Images define identity, not poses, backgrounds or sheet layouts.
Exactly ONE A and ONE B. Equal standing height, excluding ornaments. No mixed identities or clones.
The staff is an added handheld prop; costumes stay unchanged.
VISUAL STYLE AND LOCATION
The heroines remain hand-drawn 2D anime with clean linework and cel shading.
Photorealistic fictional Shibuya rooftop at dusk: concrete, one rear wall and distant buildings. Match lighting and shadows while preserving illustrated faces.
Sharp violet magic, luminous arcs and sparks. Keep character silhouettes clear.
A stays screen-left; B stays screen-right near the wall socket. Both stand on the same level, about two meters apart. Keep screen direction and one consistent location.
No pedestrians, enemies, moving traffic or building destruction.

STAFF, CABLE AND SOCKET — CONTINUITY PRIORITY
ONE straight staff with a dark shaft and a simple round metal head containing a violet core. Its physical shape never changes.
A holds it upright in her right hand, with the base resting on the roof. She keeps this position during charging and unplugging.
ONE continuous black power cable is permanently attached to the staff's base. It runs visibly along the floor, then up to ONE white wall outlet beside B at waist height.
The cable ends in ONE ordinary black plug with two flat parallel metal pins.
The plug is fully inserted at the opening. All props already exist.
Keep this route and attachment. No extra cables, plugs or outlets.
B grips the plastic plug body with her right hand and pulls it straight out of the socket. She never pulls the cable itself or touches the pins.
The cable remains attached to the staff after unplugging. B continues holding the disconnected plug.
The spell stays fully active until the pins visibly clear the outlet. Only then does it switch off.
The staff, cable, outlet, characters and city remain physically intact. Only magical light and energy disappear.
VOICE
Exactly ONE spoken sentence.
Between 0.3 and 1.8 seconds, A confidently says in Japanese, using @Audio 1: 「せかいよ、おわれ！」
Synchronize only A's lips to this line. Finish before 2.0 seconds.
The audio reference defines her voice, not the script. Never replay its recorded words.
B produces no speech or vocal reaction.
After 2.0 seconds, neither heroine produces dialogue, improvised words, gasps, grunts, screams, sighs, laughter, humming or audible breaths. No narration or inner monologue.
Physical effects and ambience continue.
0.0–3.5s — OVERWHELMING MAGIC
Begin with a stable, dramatic medium-wide two-shot.
A holds the upright staff and speaks the single line. B stands beside the wall, calmly watching.
The violet core ignites. A huge luminous sphere forms directly above the staff head, linked to it by a short energy column.
The sphere expands to approximately three meters across. Violet arcs circulate around it, sparks climb upward and a magical wind lifts the heroines' loose fabric and hair slightly.
Use powerful light and bass; both characters stay in place.
The spell is charging only. No projectile, beam or actual world destruction.
Keep A's speaking face readable. No obscuring smoke or white flash.
3.5–6.0s — THE ORDINARY POWER SOURCE
Cut to a clear view of the staff base, the black cable on the floor and its route toward B's wall outlet.
A's spell remains active at the same intensity.
B follows the cable with her eyes, then looks at the plug. Her lips stay closed. No conversation or invitation gesture.
Briefly frame the fully inserted plug and outlet as an ordinary household connection.
By 6.0 seconds, B's right hand has grasped the plastic plug body. It remains inserted. She has not disconnected it yet.
Do not move the staff or detach the cable from its base.
6.0–9.0s — UNPLUGGING ENDS EVERYTHING
Cut to a locked three-quarter view that includes B's hand and outlet clearly in the foreground, with A's staff and active magical sphere visible to the left.
Keep the extraction and magical shutdown in ONE continuous shot.
Around 8.0 seconds, B pulls the plug straight out once. Show a brief separation with both metal pins visibly outside the socket.
At that exact moment, the giant sphere, energy column, violet arcs, sparks and magical wind all switch off together.
The sphere vanishes instantly like a powered light. No fade, explosion or second spell.
The staff's core becomes dark while its metal head and shaft stay unchanged.
The scene returns to its original dusk lighting, not total darkness.
Stop the music and magical roar at disconnection. A small plastic click and a brief descending power-down sound, then quiet.
B keeps holding the unplugged black plug. Her mouth stays closed.
9.0–12.0s — THE AWKWARD REALIZATION
Return to the original medium two-shot.
A remains in her grand casting pose, holding the now-inert staff upright.
She looks up at the empty space where the sphere was, then down toward the staff and across to the disconnected plug in B's hand.
Her proud smile disappears.
B remains relaxed beside the outlet, holding the plug near her waist. No conversational gestures or vocals.
Let the exposed power connection explain the joke.
Clearly show the empty outlet and intact cable.

12.0–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Cut to A's face.
Preserve her exact reference features. Eyes widen, pupils become slightly smaller, eyebrows rise and lips part once into a small stunned expression.
Hold the mouth still afterward. No repeated lip movements or vocal sound.
Use her familiar uncomprehending face, without crying, blush or an exaggerated scream.
Apply a short, controlled push-in. Hold the final full second.
End directly on A's silent face. No cut back, reconnection or extra gag.
SOUND
Opening: dramatic instrumental percussion, low strings, a deep magical charging hum and sharp energy crackles. No choir or vocal samples.
The ordinary plug click must be distinct.
At disconnection, abruptly remove the music, charging hum and energy sounds. Allow only the short power-down sound.
Afterward, faint rooftop wind and distant city ambience. No comedy sting or canned laughter.
EXCLUDE
Text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, clones, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, redesigns, injury, electrocution, gore, camera rotation or extra characters.

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk type, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by contemporary food branding and high-end magazine design.

Use only one physical mechanism per poster, keep cause and effect instantly readable, all deformation must follow real physics rather than random digital distortion, untouched typography should remain clean, geometric, strong, and legible.

prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Max Prompt
[MiniMax H3 Max | 15s | Omni Reference | 2D Anime]

Create a premium 2D Japanese anime action-comedy scene with cinematic camera work, smooth sakuga motion, powerful effects, expressive acting, and precise comedic timing.

REFERENCE:
Use Character Sheet 1 for Character 1 and Character Sheet 2 for Character 2.
Use Voice Reference 1 only for Character 1.
Preserve both characters exactly as shown in the references. Do not redesign, merge, swap, simplify, or alter them.
Character 2 has NO dialogue.

ROLES:
Character 1 = serious attacker / setup.
Character 2 = calm counter / punchline.

CORE:
Character 1 unleashes an ultimate sword slash toward Character 2.
Character 2 jumps onto that exact flying slash and rides it away like a surfboard.
Character 1 is left staring in disbelief.
The first half must feel like a completely serious anime battle.

SPATIAL BLOCKING — CRITICAL:
Character 1 and Character 2 begin about 6–8 meters apart.
Character 1 stands LEFT, facing RIGHT.
Character 2 stands RIGHT, facing LEFT.
They clearly face each other as opponents.
Do NOT make them face the same direction or place one behind the other.
Do NOT place them too close or extremely far apart.
Maintain a clear LEFT-to-RIGHT battle axis.
The slash travels directly from Character 1 toward Character 2 across the visible gap.

SETTING:
Wide open Japanese urban riverside or city street at dramatic sunset.
Clear battle space, distant buildings, wind, dust, and small debris.
Only the two characters are present.

STYLE:
Feature-film-quality 2D Japanese anime, cinematic lighting, smooth animation, expressive faces, hand-drawn energy effects.
No photorealism, live action, or 3D CGI.

SEQUENCE:

0.0–3.0 sec
Start with a WIDE SIDE VIEW.
Character 1 stands LEFT, facing RIGHT.
Character 2 stands 6–8 meters away on the RIGHT, facing LEFT.
Both clearly look at each other.
Hold this face-to-face composition briefly.

Character 1 slowly draws the sword while staring at Character 2.
Supernatural pressure gathers around the blade.
Wind rises, dust lifts, stones tremble, and the air distorts.

3.0–5.8 sec
Close-up of Character 1's eyes looking toward Character 2.
Cut to hands tightening around the sword.
Energy rapidly gathers around the blade.

Character 1 steps TOWARD Character 2 and performs ONE powerful horizontal strike while shouting:

「これで終わりだ！」

Delivery: powerful, serious, confident, dramatic.
Use Voice Reference 1 with natural Japanese lip sync.

At the final syllable, release a gigantic crescent-shaped energy slash.
Make it devastating: luminous curved blade-wave, bright core, sharp edges, wind pressure, sparks, dust, brief impact frame.

The slash travels LEFT TO RIGHT directly toward Character 2.
Show enough travel distance for the direction to be unmistakable.

5.8–8.0 sec
Cut to Character 2 on the RIGHT side, still facing LEFT toward Character 1.
The enormous slash rapidly approaches from the LEFT.

Character 2 shows no fear and says nothing.
They slightly narrow their eyes as if noticing an opportunity.

At the last possible moment, Character 2 jumps upward.

8.0–10.8 sec
COMEDIC REVEAL.

In brief slow motion, Character 2 lands BOTH feet directly on top of the SAME moving crescent energy slash.
Character 2 is not injured.
Return immediately to normal speed.

The same slash continues flying RIGHT.
Character 2 rides it like a surfboard with one foot forward, one foot behind, arms naturally balancing.

CRITICAL:
The slash remains supernatural sword energy.
Do NOT transform it into a physical surfboard.
Do NOT make Character 2 independently fly.
Character 2 must remain visibly standing on and moving with the exact same slash released by Character 1.

Character 2 remains silent.

10.8–12.8 sec
Wide cinematic tracking shot.
Character 2 continues riding the slash farther to the RIGHT.

No dialogue.
No goodbye gesture.
No extra vocalization.

Character 2 simply rides away as if this is completely normal.
The slash leaves a long glowing trail.
Slightly reduce the dramatic music so the visual itself becomes the joke.

12.8–15.0 sec
HARD CUT.

FRONTAL CLOSE-UP of Character 1.
Camera is DIRECTLY IN FRONT of Character 1's face.
The face is centered and fills most of the frame.

STRICT CAMERA RULE:
Straight-on frontal angle only.
No side profile.
No three-quarter angle.
No over-the-shoulder.
Do not show Character 2.

Character 1 stares forward in complete disbelief.
The supernatural aura is gone.
Hold a short silent beat.

Eyes slightly widen.
Mouth barely opens.
Confidence completely gone.

Character 1 quietly says:

「……は？」

Delivery: very quiet, genuinely confused, deadpan.
Use Voice Reference 1 with natural Japanese lip sync.

After the line, hold the same FRONT-FACING CLOSE-UP with no camera movement.
End immediately.

COMEDIC TIMING:
The first 7 seconds must look like a legitimate serious anime battle.
No exaggerated comedy before Character 2 lands on the slash.
The main punchline is Character 2 riding the attack.
No extra joke afterward.

CONTINUITY:
Maintain the LEFT-RIGHT battle axis.
The slash clearly originates from Character 1 and travels continuously toward Character 2.
Character 2 jumps onto that exact same attack.
No teleportation, sudden proximity changes, side switching, independent flying, replacement attack, or extra powers.

DIALOGUE LOCK:
Character 1 speaks exactly TWO times.
Character 2 speaks ZERO times.
No repeated, improvised, overlapping, or off-screen dialogue.
No narrator.

AUDIO:
Cinematic sword draw, deep energy buildup, strong wind, heavy release impact, rushing energy, landing sound, strong wind during the ride.
Reduce dramatic music at the comedic reveal.
For the final close-up: almost total silence, faint ambient wind, then 「……は？」.

NEGATIVE:
No subtitles, captions, on-screen text, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, UI, extra or duplicated characters, character fusion, costume changes, hairstyle changes, weapon swapping, malformed hands, extra limbs, chibi transformation, photorealism, 3D CGI, characters standing too close, characters facing the same direction, Character 2 dialogue, unnecessary dialogue, or extra jokes after the final reaction.

Preserve the supplied character and voice references consistently from beginning to end.
