prompts.text:
Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / DRINK]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [PRESS / SCOOP / SMEAR / LAYER / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European café branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the typography and food as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction must visibly change the structure of the letters through believable physics.

Examples: PRESS, food weight compresses and locally deforms the typography; SCOOP, a real scoop removes material directly from a letter, leaving a matching cavity and revealing edible material inside; SMEAR, a knife drags food across the type, causing localized lateral stretching and shear only along the contact zone; LAYER, the typography contains real food layers, and one structural layer is physically pulled out and offset.

Keep the interaction localized, clear, and physically believable, untouched parts of the typography should remain hard, clean, geometric, and readable, use only one main physical mechanism per poster, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, or digital-looking distortion.

Add small editorial information such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], use strong scale contrast rather than traditional menu rows, avoid long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, or template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, or prices, keep the color system minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, and instantly understandable at thumbnail size, the key idea is simple: food does not decorate the typography, food physically changes it.

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体使用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，不做脏旧、褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和数字渐变。

在大色域附近加入非常小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【核心动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做商品陈列。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；英文类别、日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。所有文字必须具有真实意义。

留白与大色域 → 大形结构 → 材料质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看大形清楚、近看纸纤维丰富、有文化叙事和材料细节的现代东方编辑海报。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Seedance 2.0 / Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese 2D anime action-comedy with synchronized dialogue, sound effects and music. Use the selected aspect ratio.

REFERENCES AND CHARACTERS
A is the character from @Image 1. B is the character from @Image 2. Preserve their exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, colors and reference drawing styles. Use the images for character appearance only, not their backgrounds, poses or reference-sheet layouts.
Use @Audio 1 only as the reference for A's voice timbre and natural pitch range. Generate the Japanese sentence written below, not the words recorded in the reference. B remains completely silent.

A and B have equal standing height, measured from soles to skull tops, excluding ornaments. Preserve each character's individual proportions. Exactly two characters throughout, with no duplicates or afterimages.

VISUAL STORY
A summons a terrifying giant tornado. B calmly uses its outer wind to dry a wet bedsheet, then folds it. A remains stuck in her dramatic casting pose, silently realizing that her ultimate attack has become a clothes dryer.

High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime, clean linework, cel shading, fluid fabric movement and expressive faces. Play the opening as a serious fantasy battle. Reveal the comedy through B's ordinary household action.
STAGING AND CONTINUITY
A broad stone plaza at dusk, with a distant empty city skyline. A stands screen-left and B screen-right, three meters apart, on level ground at equal camera depth. Keep their screen positions and body scale consistent.

One enormous gray tornado forms in the center background, twenty meters behind them. The funnel connects the ground to dark swirling clouds. After forming, its position and size stay stable. Neither character enters the funnel. Only its outer wind reaches B's sheet. Leaves and dust spiral around the tornado; buildings remain intact.

B holds one plain pale-blue rectangular bedsheet, approximately one meter wide and one and a half meters long. Initially it is visibly wet: dark damp patches, heavy sagging and water dripping from the bottom edge. She holds its two upper corners, one in each hand. The same sheet remains visible throughout. No laundry basket or additional props.
SHOT 1 — SUMMONING, approximately 0–4 seconds
Wide full-body two-shot with both characters, the complete bedsheet and enough sky to show the tornado's scale.

A plants her feet and raises her right hand. Behind them, a circular blast of dust rapidly grows into a towering rotating funnel. Clouds twist overhead, grit skips across the plaza and both characters' hair and clothing flutter. Add a brief controlled camera tremor as the tornado reaches full size.

A confidently speaks one Japanese sentence:
「まちごと、ふきとばしてやる！」

Start the line around 0.3 seconds and finish before 3 seconds. Use A's referenced voice with accurate lip synchronization. Her mouth then closes into a proud smile. She keeps her right arm raised to sustain the tornado.
B already holds the wet sheet below chest level, with its bottom edge above the ground. Show droplets falling clearly against the stone floor. She calmly looks from the dripping sheet to the enormous tornado.

Sound: grand instrumental brass and strings, rising wind and a deep magical surge. Keep the dialogue clear above the effects.

SHOT 2 — THE ULTIMATE CLOTHES DRYER, approximately 4–12 seconds
Cut to a stable medium-wide two-shot. Include both faces, B's hands, the entire sheet and the tornado in the background. Keep this shot uninterrupted through the drying and folding so the transformation is clearly visible.
B lifts the two upper corners to shoulder height and spreads the wet sheet. Her face stays visible above the top edge. She turns the broad surface of the fabric into the tornado's outer wind.

The sheet suddenly snaps taut and flaps vigorously. B holds both corners firmly, remaining planted with a relaxed expression. Her hands make small natural adjustments against the pull. The sheet stays below her face and never wraps around either character.

At the first sharp fabric snap, abruptly stop the dramatic music. Bring the domestic laundry-flapping sound forward over the wind.

Show a continuous, readable drying process:
First, droplets spray from the lower edge.
Then, the dripping stops.
The dark damp patches visibly shrink and disappear.
The same sheet becomes uniformly pale blue and billows more lightly.

Keep the sheet's size and rectangular shape unchanged. No magical glow, steam cloud, instant replacement or disappearing fabric. The tornado keeps spinning at full size behind them.
Once the sheet is dry, B lowers it close to her body to reduce the wind's pull. She brings its upper corners together for one simple vertical fold. She drapes the doubled sheet over her left forearm and smooths it once with her right palm. Show continuous hand movement, with no instant folded stack.

B gives the dry sheet a small satisfied smile.

A watches the entire process while keeping her right hand raised. Her proud smile slowly fades. She does not speak or lower her casting arm.

Sound: sharp fabric flaps, brief water droplets, then soft cloth rustling. Keep a quieter continuous wind rumble beneath these sounds. No music or vocal reactions.

SHOT 3 — SILENT DISBELIEF, approximately 12–15 seconds
Cut to a frontal close-up of A. Keep part of her raised right forearm visible at the frame edge. The tornado continues rotating in the blurred background.
A's eyes widen, pupils become small and eyebrows rise. Her lips part slightly once and remain still. Use her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression: she cannot believe her devastating magic was used for laundry. No crying, blush or exaggerated panic.
Make a short, slow push-in. Hold her expression for the final full second. Her hair continues fluttering, and her right arm remains raised to sustain the tornado.
End directly on A's silent face. No spell cancellation, cut back to B or additional gag.
VOICE AND AUDIO RULES
Only A's single opening sentence is spoken. After 3 seconds, both characters produce zero vocal sound: no additional dialogue, narration, gasps, screams, grunts, laughter or vocal breaths. Sound effects continue.
Use instrumental music only during the opening. After the laundry reveal, use wind and fabric sounds only. No choir, vocal samples, comedy sting or canned laughter.

AVOID
Subtitles, captions, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD, extra characters, duplicate bodies, extra sheets, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, costume changes, changing character height, flying characters, injury, photorealism, 3D rendering or chibi redesign.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】
【主标题】
【核心大色域】
【结构方式】
【主色调】
【微型文化场景】
【人物动作】
【文化器物】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】

设计一张现代东方文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」为核心。

背景使用温润的暖象牙白手工纸，保留约 45%–60% 大面积留白。使用【核心大色域】建立第一视觉，根据【结构方式】形成清楚、有方法感的大形关系，可以通过纤维放射、纸面镂空、裂缝连接、正负形转换或拓印痕迹表达主题，但不要直接做成普通写实物体。

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体采用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，远看首先看到大形和色彩关系，近看才发现材料细节。

在大色域附近加入尺度很小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【人物动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做摆拍或商品陈列。

人物统一采用二维纸本淡彩插画画法：五官简洁、轻体积、完整平面色块、少量连续衣褶线，与纸张和色域属于同一个视觉世界。避免摄影真人感、3D 微缩模型、CGI 光影、强投影和真实景深。

微型场景与巨大主视觉之间建立一处真实的尺度连接，例如纤维、纸屑、裂隙、锔钉、墨迹、工具轨迹或材料本身，让“小手工动作”自然延展成“大色域结构”。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。文字不抢主视觉，不加入无意义占位词。

整体阅读顺序为：

留白与大色域 → 结构关系 → 纸纤维质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看抓眼、近看有纸感、有细节、有文化故事的东方编辑海报。

避免巨大标题、普通国风插画、写实人物、3D 微缩模型、摄影背景、PPT 网格、商业广告感、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、CGI、玻璃或镜面材质、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

subject_definitions:

[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second Japanese 2D anime comedy. A summons a terrifying fireball overhead. B uses it to toast an oversized marshmallow, then takes a stretchy bite. End on A's silent disbelief while she still holds the fireball overhead. Use the selected aspect ratio.

detailed_description:
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime, clean linework, cel shading, fluid motion and expressive faces. A spacious stone courtyard at dusk. Exactly two human bodies, one A and one B. No duplicates or human-shaped afterimages.
Both have equal standing height from soles to skull tops, excluding ornaments. Establish equal camera depth and level ground. Maintain body scale across cuts. A stays screen-left and B screen-right.
ONE orange-red fireball, about three meters across, hovers above A's raised right palm. Its lower edge stays above her head. Flame bands and sparks create spectacle without hiding faces. After forming, it stays in the same position and at the same size. A keeps her right arm raised until the end. She never throws the orb.

B holds ONE long wooden skewer with ONE head-sized white cylindrical marshmallow near its far end. The blunt tip is buried inside the marshmallow. The skewer reaches the fireball's lower-right edge while B's hands and body remain safely distant. Neither prop changes size or duplicates.
[Shot 1] Open on a wide full-body two-shot with room above for the fireball. A stands left and B right, about two and a half meters apart. B holds the skewer diagonally beside her, marshmallow clear of the ground.

class PapercraftTitleLogo:
    def __init__(self, SERIES):
        s = infer(SERIES)                      # technique, icon, props, accents, compose
        self.s = s

        letters = paper_masses(SERIES.title, technique=self.s.technique)          # P₁
        icon    = paper_masses(self.s.icon, technique=self.s.technique)           # P₂ same medium
        mark    = integrate(letters, icon, relation=self.s.relation)              # P₂ integration

        assert shadows_consistent(img, SINGLE_LIGHT) and contact(img),       "P₄: flat scan / floating"

detailed_description:
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime with clean linework, cel shading, fluid motion and expressive faces. A spacious stone courtyard at dusk. Exactly two characters: A screen-left, B screen-right, initially two meters apart on level ground at equal camera depth. Maintain screen direction and consistent character scale.

Between four and six seconds, B bends her knees and grips the lower frame with both hands near two adjacent corners on the side facing A. Her fingers visibly wrap around the iron. She begins lifting. The entire cage rises as one piece and an empty gap opens beneath the lower frame. Show the paving remaining on the ground. Nothing breaks or bends.

Still supporting it with both hands, she bends her knees and ducks her head beneath that raised edge, stepping toward screen-left through the open bottom. Her head, shoulders and body pass BELOW the lower frame, never through a bar. She emerges fully outside on the side nearest A.

B straightens outside the cage, retaining a firm two-handed grip on the same lower-frame section. She then raises the entire cage until its open bottom is above A's head. Show effortless cartoon strength with continuous hand contact. No independent levitation.

Between eight and eleven seconds, B takes a short step toward A and shifts the raised cage leftward until its open bottom is directly above A. B stands to the right of the cage, outside its footprint, with both hands supporting the near lower edge. A stays in place, arms folded, looking upward as her confidence disappears.

B lowers the cage vertically around A in one controlled motion. Its frame clears A's hair, shoulders and arms without touching her. A enters through the open bottom as the walls descend around her. No bars pass through either body.

By eleven seconds, the lower frame lands flat on the paving with one solid metallic CLUNK. A is inside; B is outside on the right. The same cage that trapped B now surrounds A. Show B releasing both hands only after it touches the ground.

B calmly brushes her palms together once. A uncrosses her arms and stares at the bars. Pause quietly. She does not try lifting it.

Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / DRINK]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [TWIST / SNAP / DRIP / PEEL / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European food branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the food and typography as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction should visibly alter the structure, surface, or material behavior of the letterforms through clear and believable physics.

Examples: TWIST, long food elements wrap around, pass in front of and behind, tighten around, and subtly pull selected letter strokes; SNAP, the food fractures along a clear force line and the typography breaks along the same continuous axis with small structural offsets; DRIP, a real liquid or glaze flows over the letters, gradually covering and replacing parts of the geometric type with edible material; PEEL, the surface of a letter is physically removed to reveal a different edible material underneath, with the peeled layer remaining visibly connected and curling away.

Keep the interaction focused on one main physical mechanism, localized deformations should follow real contact, weight, tension, gravity, viscosity, fracture, or material separation, untouched areas of the typography should remain clean, hard, geometric, and readable, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, floating food pieces, or digital-looking distortion.

Use a broken editorial grid with strong scale contrast, asymmetric placement, edge information, large negative space, and small meaningful annotations such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], avoid traditional menu rows, long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final image should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and immediately understandable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal how the food has physically changed the typography.

prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Prompt
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is A, the black-haired heroine from <Picture 1>. Preserve her exact face, hair, costume, accessories, proportions and hand-drawn 2D style.
<Subject 2> is B, the white-haired heroine from <Picture 2>. Preserve her exact face, hair, costume, accessories, proportions and hand-drawn 2D style.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1).
<Audio 2> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2> (S2).
summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] Create a 15-second action-comedy using the selected aspect ratio. <Subject 1> slices one onion with spectacular sword technique, then her tears become two fountains. <Subject 2> calmly opens an umbrella inside the kitchen. End on <Subject 1>'s familiar stunned face with tears running down her cheeks. <Audio 1> and <Audio 2> guide the two assigned voices only.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - exact character identity and reference art style; new actions and expressions.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - exact character identity and reference art style; new actions and poses.
<Audio 1>: reference - vocal identity and natural pitch only; no copied recording or original words.
<Audio 2>: reference - vocal identity and natural pitch only; no copied recording or original words.
The images define character identities, not first frames, poses or backgrounds. Each image supplies ONE character; never reproduce reference-sheet panels or merge designs.
detailed_description:
Hand-drawn 2D anime heroines with clean lines and cel shading in a photorealistic modern kitchen, with soft nighttime city lights outside. Exactly two characters, one kitchen island, one onion, one cutting board, one katana and one umbrella; keep their identities and scale consistent.
[Shot 1] A static medium two-shot shows <Subject 1> screen-left and <Subject 2> screen-right behind the island. A peeled onion with a flat base rests on the board in front of <Subject 1>. She holds the katana in her right hand; her left hand stays away from the blade. <Subject 2> holds a closed dark-purple umbrella vertically beside her.
Between 0.1 and 0.9 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1) confidently says in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, [Japanese] まかせて! Synchronize her lips accurately.
She immediately makes TWO fast downward cuts, splitting the onion into several thick pieces that stay on the board. Show blade contact clearly. Short teal slash trails, sharp swishes and cutting impacts make this look like a finishing move. The actual blade and food remain visible; no smoke or whiteout.
By 2.5 seconds, cutting is finished. <Subject 1> lays the katana flat behind the board, blade pointing screen-left away from <Subject 2>, and smiles proudly. The sword remains there afterward.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, cut to a chest-up view of <Subject 1>, with the chopped onion visible below. The teal effects have faded. Her satisfied smile holds briefly.
At approximately 4 seconds, tears collect at both lower eyelids and run down her cheeks. The streams gradually thicken while she tries to maintain her confident expression. Keep her eyes open and her mouth silent. The crying is entirely visual: no sobs, sniffles, gasps or vocal breaths.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, cut back to a static medium two-shot. Keep this shot uninterrupted until the next cut.
The tears visibly grow from <Subject 1>'s two lower eyelids into TWO transparent blue-white water arcs. Each remains attached to its eye, rises outward, then falls under gravity. Her eyes retain their normal anatomy and her face stays readable.
The left arc splashes onto the empty left counter and floor. The right arc curves toward <Subject 2>.
As the arcs grow, <Subject 2> lifts the SAME closed umbrella and opens it above her head. Show the canopy spreading open before the falling right arc reaches her.
The right stream strikes the canopy, scatters into droplets and pours from its edges. <Subject 2> remains calm beneath it. Shallow puddles form; furniture and characters stay in place.
Every drop originates from <Subject 1>'s eyes. The indoor shower effect is entirely eye fountains and umbrella runoff. No ceiling rain, clouds, faucets, mouth fountain or water from <Subject 2>. These are liquid streams, not magical beams.
At 9.5-10.4 seconds, <Subject 2> (S2) looks toward <Subject 1> and says in the relaxed voice timbre referenced from <Audio 2>, [Japanese] 雨だね. Synchronize her lips; briefly lower water sounds beneath the line.
<Subject 1> silently looks toward the umbrella, settling into bewilderment. No falling, slipping, new action or extra joke.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, cut to <Subject 1>'s face. The large arcs gently diminish into two thick tear streams running down her cheeks.
Her expression is the familiar stunned, uncomprehending face: slightly widened eyes, subtly raised eyebrows, lips slightly parted and held still. Preserve normal facial proportions; no exaggerated sadness or distorted crying face.
A small, slow push-in ends in a steady close-up. Hold the final full second with flowing tears and no speech. End directly on her face.
Throughout the video, only the two written sentences are spoken. No narration, extra words, laughter or vocal reactions. No subtitles, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD, extra characters, duplicate bodies, extra limbs, costume changes, injury, kitchen destruction or chibi redesign.
overall_soundscape:
Quiet kitchen room tone throughout. Two short sword swishes and cutting impacts during [Shot 1]. Light dripping in [Shot 2]. A watery fountain burst, one umbrella-opening pop, splashes and canopy runoff in [Shot 3]. Gentle water flow in [Shot 4]. No audible sobbing or canned laughter.
non_diegetic_music:
Energetic instrumental percussion and strings during the cutting, easing into a brief triumphant phrase afterward. Stop the music completely at the fountain burst around 6 seconds. No singing, choir or vocal samples. Afterward, only dialogue, water and room ambience.

// ── SEMANTIC INFERENCE ──────────────────────────────────────────
TITLE          = infer_paper_title($ TOPIC)             // e.g. "Attention Residual Connections in a 93-Layer Deep Network"
SUBTITLE       = infer_method_subtitle($ TOPIC)         // one-line description
KEY_IDEA       = infer_central_mechanism($ TOPIC)       // what the paper actually proposes
HERO_SCHEMATIC = infer_main_diagram($ TOPIC)            // layer stack, network graph, pipeline, etc.
EQUATION_STEPS = infer_equations($ TOPIC, count=5..7)   // ordered derivation chain
STATS          = infer_sidebar_stats($ TOPIC, count=4)  // totals, counts, parameters, memory 
LEGEND         = infer_legend_items($ TOPIC, count=4..6)
METAPHOR       = infer_real_world_metaphor($ TOPIC)     // "assembly line workers", "relay race", "library access"
BOTTOM_PANEL   = infer_bottom_system($ TOPIC)           // the learnable component (queries, attn weights, memory bank)
PALETTE        = infer_academic_palette($ TOPIC)        // light blue background, red connections, slate text

// ── SPATIAL LAYOUT FIELD ───────────────────────────────────────
L(x,y) = panel_weight(TITLE, HERO, METAPHOR, EQUATIONS, LEGEND, BOTTOM)
F = ∇L                    // reading flow: title → hero → derivation → metaphor → bottom
Curl = ∇×L                // layered nesting, curved connection arcs, metaphor loops
Div  = ∇·L                // density of connection lines, arrowheads, callouts

// ── HERO SCHEMATIC (CENTER) ────────────────────────────────────
// A vertical or diagonal stack of translucent blue layers.
LAYER_COUNT = infer_hero_depth($ TOPIC)              // e.g. 93
LAYERS      = for i in 1..LAYER_COUNT:
    layer_shape = translucent_blue_slab(
        thin=true, edges=soft_highlight,
        label=f"Layer {i}" on left margin for key indices
    )
    layer_index = layer_shape in vertical stack with isometric tilt
// Curved red connection arcs sweep from each layer to later layers
for each target layer t:
    for each source layer s in 1..t-1:
        draw_arc(from=s, to=t, color=red, arrowhead, taper=true)
// Also draw base "RAW INPUT" plane at bottom of stack, with arrows rising into all layers.
// Anchors q₁, q₂, ..., qN (pseudo-queries) sit at each layer with small blue cubes.

// ── TITLE BLOCK (TOP-LEFT) ─────────────────────────────────────
TITLE_BLOCK = {
    line_1 : TITLE in bold navy sans,
    line_2 : SUBTITLE smaller gray sans,
    body   : KEY_IDEA in compact paragraph,
    legend : LEGEND with tiny icons,
    callout: "KEY IDEA" boxed note with accent border
}

// ── SIDEBAR STATS (LEFT-MIDDLE) ────────────────────────────────
for each stat in STATS:
    icon  = small pictogram (chip, network, cube, layer)
    label = stat. name
    value = stat.value in large bold
    math  = stat.formula if applicable

// ── EQUATION COLUMN (RIGHT OF HERO) ────────────────────────────
for each step in EQUATION_STEPS:
    rounded_rounded_box with light red border

Prompt:

TITLE: [poster title]
CONCEPT WORDS: [3–4 related words]

GRAPHIC SYSTEMS: [dots / wave lines / concentric arcs / offset contours / radiating lines]
EVENT TYPE: [sound art / exhibition / live performance / cultural program]
EVENT INFO: [date / time / venue]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-end experimental typography poster where oversized English words become the main visual system.

Use 3–4 layered words with clear conceptual relationships. Do not simply place normal bold text and apply textures inside it. Rebuild the letterforms directly from precise geometric systems such as dot matrices, parallel wave lines, concentric or eccentric arcs, stepped contours, offset registrations, radiating segments, and frequency-like line bundles.

Give different text layers different graphic behaviors, then connect them through controlled transitions: dots may stretch into lines, arcs may open into waves, waves may shift or drift, and line systems may gradually realign. The poster should feel like one evolving typographic field rather than several separate effects.

Use overlap, compression, partial cropping, displacement, and negative space to create dense multi-layer typography. Maintain strong density contrast: some areas highly compressed and bright, some medium-density, and some deliberately open.

Keep all dots and lines exceptionally clean, sharp, continuous, and intentional. Smooth curves, consistent spacing, clear endpoints, stable dot shapes, no accidental broken lines, fuzzy edges, random noise, messy moiré, glitch artifacts, or low-quality AI textures.

Use a restrained, high-contrast color palette with one dominant background, one main typography color, and only small accent areas.

Reserve the lower 25%–30% for a refined editorial information section with the poster title, one short concept sentence, 2–3 program items, date, time, venue, and program name. Use clean modern sans-serif typography, multiple hierarchy levels, thin divider lines, and an asymmetric cultural-poster grid.

The final image should work at three distances: a strong abstract composition at thumbnail size, readable layered typography at medium distance, and rich geometric detail up close.

The food must not simply sit beside, overlap, or decorate the letters, it should physically affect the typography through believable contact, force, displacement, construction, compression, cutting, or structural transformation.

Use only one main physical mechanism per poster, keep the force path and cause-and-effect relationship clear, all movement and deformation must follow real contact and material behavior, untouched typography should remain clean, rigid, geometric, and readable.

prompts.text:
A fun prompt for these types of visuals. AI picked the topics. 😄

2x2 grid, 16:9, AI picks topics: Create a richly detailed single-panel editorial cartoon about [SUBJECT], using one strong visual metaphor that instantly explains the critique. The image should look like a polished newspaper/op-ed political cartoon: exaggerated caricatures, expressive faces, dynamic inked linework, hand-painted color, satirical humor, and clear symbolic storytelling.  CORE ENGINE :: SUBJECT([SUBJECT]) + POWER_ACTOR(infer the main person/group/institution most associated with the subject) + VICTIMS(infer the ordinary people / public / workers / taxpayers / citizens affected) + METAPHOR(infer one bold physical scenario that dramatizes the issue) + LABELS(add large readable signs, banners, placards, speech bubbles, and object labels) + HYPOCRISY_CONTRAST(show public slogan vs hidden reality) = editorial cartoon  SCENE RULES :: - Build the image around ONE dominant allegorical setup, not multiple unrelated scenes. - The dominant setup should be a theatrical, physical metaphor for the issue:   examples of metaphor types = collapsing structure, overloaded platform, staged performance, fake façade, circus act, burden-bearing, puppet show, shell game, disaster cover-up, hollow reform, gilded platform, toxic machine, leaking dam, etc. - The main power actor should be oversized, smug, theatrical, or oblivious. - The affected people should appear strained, ignored, burdened, tricked, or sidelined. - Show the issue through contradiction: what is promised in words versus what is really happening in the picture. - Include 4–10 readable labels on props/signs/sacks/podiums/posters/banners to make the idea explicit. - Include 1–2 speech bubbles or slogan boards if useful. - Make the labels feel topic-specific and inferred from [SUBJECT], not generic filler. - Add a meaningful background location that strengthens the message: government building, skyline, industrial zone, stage, field, media event, etc. - The joke should be immediately understandable even without outside context.  VISUAL STYLE :: classic American editorial cartoon high-detail pen-and-ink outlines painted digital watercolor / gouache coloring warm, slightly textured paper feel expressive caricature anatomy busy but readable composition dramatic gestures and facial expressions clear silhouette hierarchy bold legible hand-lettered text newspaper-opinion illustration quality humorous but biting tone  COMPOSITION :: - horizontal single-panel composition - one main focal metaphor in the center - secondary labeled details around it - foreground citizens / audience / workers for emotional grounding - midground action carries the satire - background provides context but does not steal focus - make the scene dense with meaning but still easy to read at a glance  AI INFERENCE LOGIC :: When [SUBJECT] changes, automatically infer: 1. the most relevant public issue or controversy 2. the key actor(s) benefiting 3. the group paying the price 4. the best metaphorical scene to symbolize it 5. the most effective slogan/label contrasts 6. the environmental setting 7. the specific props, signs, and labels that make the satire land  TEXT / LABELING RULE :: Render clean, readable English text directly inside the artwork. Use short punchy labels like: - slogan / promise text - burden / cost text - distraction / spin text - victims’ needs - loopholes / favors / excuses - public-relations branding versus ugly reality Keep the text concise and integrated naturally into the cartoon.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

TITLE: [poster title]
CONCEPT WORDS: [3–4 related words]
BACKGROUND COLOR: [color]
PRIMARY COLOR: [color]
ACCENT COLOR: [color]
GRAPHIC SYSTEMS: [dots / wave lines / concentric arcs / offset contours / radiating lines]
EVENT TYPE: [sound art / exhibition / live performance / cultural program]
EVENT INFO: [date / time / venue]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-end experimental typography poster where oversized English words become the main visual system.

Use 3–4 layered words with clear conceptual relationships. Do not simply place normal bold text and apply textures inside it. Rebuild the letterforms directly from precise geometric systems such as dot matrices, parallel wave lines, concentric or eccentric arcs, stepped contours, offset registrations, radiating segments, and frequency-like line bundles.

Give different text layers different graphic behaviors, then connect them through controlled transitions: dots may stretch into lines, arcs may open into waves, waves may shift or drift, and line systems may gradually realign. The poster should feel like one evolving typographic field rather than several separate effects.

Use overlap, compression, partial cropping, displacement, and negative space to create dense multi-layer typography. Maintain strong density contrast: some areas highly compressed and bright, some medium-density, and some deliberately open.

Keep all dots and lines exceptionally clean, sharp, continuous, and intentional. Smooth curves, consistent spacing, clear endpoints, stable dot shapes, no accidental broken lines, fuzzy edges, random noise, messy moiré, glitch artifacts, or low-quality AI textures.

Use a restrained, high-contrast color palette with one dominant background, one main typography color, and only small accent areas.

Reserve the lower 25%–30% for a refined editorial information section with the poster title, one short concept sentence, 2–3 program items, date, time, venue, and program name. Use clean modern sans-serif typography, multiple hierarchy levels, thin divider lines, and an asymmetric cultural-poster grid.

The final image should work at three distances: a strong abstract composition at thumbnail size, readable layered typography at medium distance, and rich geometric detail up close.

prompts.text:
A hybrid style I used to visualize street food. Works for other topics too. 
16:9, 2x2 grid, do this for 4 international street foodsCONCEPT ANCHOR 1: "Concept-driven black-and-white logo design — letters transformed into symbolic forms, clever wordmark geometry, negative space, visual puns, monochrome iconography, subject-shaped typography"

::

CONCEPT ANCHOR 2: "Appetizing oversized 3D advertising typography — glossy dimensional letters, tactile edible textures, bold flavor cues, dramatic lighting, ingredient layering, juicy high-impact commercial poster energy"

::

CONCEPT ANCHOR 3: "Elegant exploded-view product anatomy poster — refined editorial layout, cream museum-paper background, premium serif typography, labeled components, technical callouts, heritage-industrial precision"

INSTRUCTION:
Find the exact visual center of these three concepts.
Ignore the literal brands, foods, and cameras.
Extract only the style DNA.

Render $ SUBJECT as a premium typographic anatomy poster where the subject’s name becomes the main visual object: partly a clever symbolic wordmark, partly a dimensional tactile sculptural form, and partly an exploded-view luxury diagram.

The final image should feel like a concept logo, a commercial hero ad, and a museum-grade product anatomy sheet at the same time.

STYLE RULES:
- Central focus: the subject name or title is the hero object.
- Typography layer: letters should intelligently morph into subject-related symbols, structures, tools, or visual metaphors.
- Material layer: the lettering becomes tactile, dimensional, appetizing, crafted, metallic, textured, or otherwise physically embodied according to the subject.
- Diagram layer: components, layers, pieces, ingredients, materials, or conceptual parts can be separated and labeled in exploded-view fashion.
- Layout: refined editorial poster hierarchy with large title, subtitles, side notes, section labels, specs, origins, and annotations.
- Color strategy: mostly restrained and elegant, with selective rich high-impact color in the main object.
- Background: clean cream/off-white poster field, minimal distractions, luxury print presentation.
- Typography: combine elegant serif editorial text with bold display lettering inferred from $SUBJECT.

OUTPUT:
A sophisticated hybrid poster for $ SUBJECT that fuses conceptual logo design, high-impact 3D typographic advertising, and premium exploded-view anatomy graphics.

设计一张宋式美学东方文化海报，将古画、书法与现代编辑排版结合。使用温暖米白宣纸背景，带细腻纸张纤维、轻微颗粒和真实印刷质感，保留大面积留白，整体安静、克制、雅致。

【画幅比例】：9:16

请为以上品牌生成一张完整的「Brand to Logo」品牌 Logo 概念探索设计稿。核心不是简单生成四个相似 Logo，而是围绕同一个品牌名称、行业属性和核心概念，提出四条真正不同的视觉设计路线。

最终画面固定为 9:16 竖版。顶部品牌输入区严格占整个画面高度的 30%，底部 Logo 展示区严格占 70%，无论品牌名称长短都不能改变这个比例；名字较长时缩小字号，不扩大顶部区域。底部 70% 再严格划分为 2×2 四个等大区域，只使用非常浅、非常细的虚线分隔，不绘制外围边框。

【顶部品牌区】

顶部只是品牌原始信息的引入区，不是主视觉海报。使用【顶部背景色】，加入极轻微的纸张、和纸、包装纸、丝网印刷颗粒或与品牌相关的低对比暗纹，只增加质感，不形成复杂插画。

顶部只保留三层信息：

BRAND TO LOGO

【品牌名称】

【英文名称】

品牌名称使用正常、清晰、现代的印刷字体，不提前进行 Logo 化、手写化或图形变形。不要加入口号、品牌说明、大量小英文、编号、印章、辅助图标或复杂光影，让视觉重点自然落到下方四个 Logo 方案。

【底部 Logo 展示区】

底部统一使用 Warm Ivory 暖米白纸张背景，只保留轻微天然纸纹。四个 Logo 都需要围绕【品牌类型】【品牌关键词】【核心视觉意象】展开，保持品牌核心一致，但设计方法必须明显不同。

每个 Logo 都应该是一套完整、可以真实用于门店、包装、标签、社交头像、名片或周边商品的品牌标识，而不是完整插画、海报或装饰图。

每个方案控制在 1–3 个主要颜色以内，优先使用【主色建议】。避免高饱和杂色、复杂渐变、3D、金属浮雕、玻璃质感和商业 mockup。

【Mascot｜吉祥物型】

从品牌名称、行业或核心意象中设计一个高度概括的角色或拟人化主体。角色需要拥有清楚的大轮廓和强记忆点，但不要做成复杂动漫人物或完整场景插画。

让角色本身与品牌概念发生关系，例如抱着产品、隐藏在物体后面、与核心植物或动物融合。搭配完整的【品牌名称】字标和较小的【英文名称】，整体亲和、有故事感、适合社交传播。

【Emblem｜意象徽章型】

不依赖完整人物，而是从【核心视觉意象】中提炼 2–3 个最重要的元素，组合成一个集中、平衡、容易缩小识别的品牌徽章。

优先使用负空间、环绕、上下叠合、局部包围或图形共形，让不同元素真正融合成一个标志，而不是简单把几个小图标并排放在一起。搭配品牌字标，形成完整稳定的 Logo 系统。

【Type-led｜字形创意型】

以【品牌名称】本身作为核心设计对象。分析中文字或英文字母中最有视觉潜力的笔画、结构、偏旁、负空间和字母轮廓，让品牌的核心意象从文字内部自然生长出来。

可以进行省笔、共享笔画、延长、切割、局部替换、负空间重构或字形融合，但必须保留基本识别度。

不要在普通字体旁边额外贴一个图标。重点是让“文字本身就是 Logo”，形成更现代、更聪明、更具有专业平面设计感的方案。

【Stamp｜开放式手作印记型】

设计一款具有手刻、版画、店章或包装印记气质的 Logo，但不要使用规整完整的方框，也不要把所有内容塞进封闭椭圆。

使用不完整边界、开放弧线、自然笔触、品牌核心图形或文字共同形成松散的视觉范围。元素可以轻微错位，边缘允许少量自然缺墨和手工印刷不均，让整体具有呼吸感。

Stamp 必须保持清楚的主次关系和充分留白。不要因为追求“印章感”而变得死板、密集或难以实际使用。

四款必须共享同一个品牌世界观、核心意象和基础配色，但不能只是同一个 Logo 换四种画风或四种排版。

不要加入 A/B/C/D 等编号。底部不要添加口号、解释句或多余信息。不要生成包装 mockup、真实门店场景或完整插画。

最终画面要像一张成熟、干净、有方法差异、有真实品牌设计价值的专业 Logo Exploration Sheet。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

[Product / Brand]: {e.g. Coca-Cola glass bottle, Starbucks cup, Nongfu Spring bottle}
[Mini World Concept]: {e.g. soda diner, coffee treehouse, mountain sanctuary, water park}
[Main Palette]: {use the product’s recognizable brand colors plus 2–3 supporting colors}
[Output Mode]: Before / after comparison
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Use the uploaded real product photo as the source.

Create one vertical 9:16 comparison image with two exactly equal sections:

Top 50%: the original product photographed naturally in a real everyday setting
Bottom 50%: the same product transformed into a hand illustrated miniature world

For the top image, keep the product realistic and recognizable. Present it like a casual smartphone photo from everyday life, not a polished studio advertisement. Use natural light, realistic reflections, slight imperfections, and a believable surrounding environment.

For the bottom image, completely redraw the product and the entire scene in a unified hand illustrated mini world style.

Do not keep the real photographic product inside the illustration.

The packaging itself must become the main architecture and structural foundation of the miniature world.

Preserve the product’s recognizable silhouette, packaging proportions, key brand colors, label placement, cap, lid, logo area, and other distinctive visual features so it remains immediately identifiable.

Reinterpret different parts of the packaging as architectural spaces such as:

rooftop terraces, balconies, cafés, shops, observation decks, stairways, windows, bridges, gardens, pools, playgrounds, or other spaces that naturally match the product and brand personality.

Build the mini world around the product’s real characteristics.

Use the flavor, ingredients, function, origin, packaging shape, brand colors, or emotional associations as design inspiration.

For example, fruit flavors may become gardens or slides, water may become waterfalls and streams, coffee may become reading terraces and cafés, and nostalgic drinks may become small neighborhood stores.

Add a few tiny people, animals, furniture, plants, and everyday activities to make the world feel alive.

Every small detail should support a clear story. Avoid random decorative objects that have no connection to the product.

Use clean hand drawn outlines, warm matte color blocks, subtle paper grain, gentle texture, and slightly imperfect handcrafted details.

The style should feel like a polished commercial picture book illustration: playful, warm, detailed, collectible, and visually rich without becoming cluttered.

Keep one clear visual hierarchy:

the product packaging is the main landmark, the miniature architecture grows from it, small characters create life and storytelling, supporting elements remain secondary.

Avoid photorealistic rendering, 3D CGI, plastic toy appearance, LEGO style, realistic miniature photography, excessive logos, random buildings, overcrowded characters, or unrelated fantasy elements.

Keep the original brand identity recognizable, but do not repeat logos or brand names excessively.

Do not add extra titles, captions, Before / After labels, borders, watermarks, or decorative typography.

The final image should make viewers immediately understand:

the same everyday product has been transformed into a complete illustrated miniature world.

Prompt:

TITLE: [BLOOM / SONIC / ORBIT / THREAD / Your title]
SUBJECT & POSE: [Adult woman, side profile / 3⁄4 profile / over-the-shoulder portrait]
GEOMETRIC FORM: [Flowing petals / sound waves / orbital curves / woven fibers]
COLOR PALETTE: [Main color + secondary color + ivory highlights]
TOP LABELS: [Left label / Right label]
SIDE TEXT: [Your short message]
TAGLINE: [Your tagline]
FOOTER: [Supporting keywords]

Create a striking 9:16 experimental editorial poster combining parametric line art, contour-line portraiture, curve stitching, and negative-space typography.

PORTRAIT

Sculpt an elegant adult woman's face, hair, neck, and shoulders entirely from hundreds of ultra-fine, smooth, continuous contour lines.

Follow natural anatomical curves, preserving expressive eyes, defined facial features, and graceful proportions. Use varying line density to create depth and sculptural volume. Favor beautiful side or 3/4 profiles.

PARAMETRIC GEOMETRY

Let the hair and body contours seamlessly transform into massive flowing structures inspired by the selected theme.

Use precise curve-stitching geometry: countless thin, individually straight lines with gradually shifting endpoints, forming sweeping curved surfaces, layered folds, and intricate spatial patterns.

Keep the line flow clean, continuous, and structurally coherent.

TYPOGRAPHY & COMPOSITION

Integrate the TITLE as massive, ultra-bold geometric sans-serif lettering, using dark negative-space cutouts within the bright line structures.

Keep the face unobstructed. Arrange small editorial labels at the top, supporting text along the side, and the tagline and footer at the bottom.

Maintain strong visual hierarchy, balanced negative space, and accurate typography.

VISUAL STYLE

Pure near-black background, high-contrast colored filaments, and subtle ivory highlights.

The portrait and geometric structures must feel like one unified artwork.

Crisp vector-like precision, elegant mathematical complexity, and gallery-quality graphic design.

Avoid photographic skin, random tangled lines, broken contours, excessive mesh noise, blurry glow, plastic CGI, distorted anatomy, illegible text, decorative numbering, starbursts, and watermarks.

Crea un póster vertical 9:16 de diseño editorial para transformar un nombre en cuatro estilos de firma.

【Color superior】{terracota / azul cobalto / oliva / ciruela / ocre}

Parte superior ~40%: fondo de color suave y poco saturado, textura sutil de papel y sombra natural de ventana. Texto pequeño: “DEL NOMBRE A LA FIRMA”. En el centro muestra 【Nombre】 en tipografía sans serif moderna y legible; debajo, el mismo nombre en MAYÚSCULAS con amplio espaciado. Respeta exactamente tildes, ñ y caracteres especiales.

FLUIDA — larga, continua, elegante, con un trazo final extendido.  
AFILADA — angular, rápida, con diagonales, cruces y trazos altos.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【中文姓名】：{例如：林知夏}  
【姓名拼音】：{例如：LIN ZHIXIA}  
【顶部背景色】：{例如：深钴蓝、灰调珊瑚、鼠尾草绿、深酒红}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请将输入的普通中文姓名重新设计成一张完整的「中文个性签名 AI Filter」设计稿。最终画面为 9:16 竖版，上方约占 40%，展示普通印刷姓名；下方约占 60%，展示同一个名字的四种完全不同的艺术手写签名。整体高级、克制、现代、有专业设计提案感，不要像普通字体样张或书法练习纸。

【顶部姓名区】

使用【顶部背景色】作为主色，加入极轻微的纸张或织物质感，并可加入柔和自然的窗影、树影或建筑光影，但不要复杂。顶部中央使用很小、字距宽松的英文“NAME TO SIGNATURE”，中央使用暖象牙白色、规整优雅的中文宋体大字展示【中文姓名】，姓名下方以小字号、宽字距大写英文显示【姓名拼音】。

这里的中文姓名必须保持普通印刷字体，不要手写、连笔或艺术变形，用来明确表现“原始输入”。除此之外不要添加额外标语、解释文案、Logo、编号或装饰图形，保持充分留白，让姓名成为上半部分绝对视觉中心。

【底部签名区】

底部统一使用暖米白色纸张，只保留非常轻微的天然纸纹，不做明显做旧、污渍或强颗粒。使用非常浅、非常细的灰褐色虚线将区域分成 2×2 四格，不需要外边框。每一格只展示一个大尺寸黑色艺术签名，以及下方很小的风格名称：飘逸、锋势、回环、极简。

四个签名全部来源于同一个【中文姓名】，但在结构、方向、节奏、抽象程度、重心和视觉人格上必须有明显差异。不要只是将完整姓名用四种相似连笔方式重新写一遍。允许大胆省笔、合笔、共享笔画、连续连写、拉长、缩写、重构和符号化，不要求每个中文字都完整可辨，重点是从姓名中提炼具有个人识别度的签名结构。

签名使用自然黑色签字笔、钢笔或 gel pen 的真实手写质感，线条带自然笔压变化：起笔较细，主笔略重，转折处有自然压力，快速拖尾逐渐变细，局部允许极轻微断墨。不要生成完全光滑的数字矢量曲线，也不要做成传统毛笔书法。

【飘逸款】

将姓名设计成横向、轻盈、流畅的艺术签名。可以高度压缩中文字形，并让多个字符共享笔画、自然连写，通过一至两条大跨度长线或拖尾把整个姓名连接为完整手势。允许牺牲部分可读性，重点表现流动节奏、速度感和优雅气质。

最终效果应像艺人、设计师或创作者自然签出的成熟个人签名，而不是清楚书写的三个中文字。整体以柔和曲线和连续笔势为主，不要堆叠过多尖角。

【锋势款】

将姓名设计成更加锋利、快速、有力量的签名。大量使用斜线、尖角、高竖笔、快速切线和干脆的收笔，把中文字形高度压缩，只保留几个最有力量的骨架结构。

整体可以明显向右倾斜，形成强烈速度感和现代感。避免大面积柔软圆环，让这款和飘逸款第一眼就形成明显区别，气质偏冷静、果断、有气场。

【回环款】

将姓名设计成以大型回环结构为核心的艺术签名。可以使用开放圆环、自由椭圆、大 S 曲线、丝带式曲线或不规则包围结构，把高度压缩后的姓名笔势自然嵌入回环内部或让其穿过回环，并允许最后一笔突破主体结构形成长收尾。

回环必须具有真人快速书写的自然感，不能像规整几何图形。整体第一眼应更像一个艺术家的个人签名符号，第二眼才感受到它来自原始中文姓名。

【极简款】

这是四种方案中最抽象、最克制的一款。不需要完整写出整个姓名，只从中文字形中提取大约 4–6 个最有识别价值的主笔，例如长横、主竖、折笔、斜线或几个点笔，再重新组合成一个高级、容易记忆的个人视觉标记。

最终效果可以接近 Personal Mark、个人 Logo 或设计师签名。第一眼不要求直接认出完整姓名，但知道原始姓名以后，应能够理解这些笔势与原字结构的关系。保持大量留白，不要添加无关圆圈、箭头、星形或其他装饰符号。

【整体控制】

四款签名必须真正体现不同的人格：飘逸款强调柔长、流动和速度；锋势款强调锐利、力量和斜向结构；回环款强调艺术性、包围关系和图形感；极简款强调省笔、符号化和个人品牌感。

不要让四款只是同一种签名修改尾笔。最终签名既要具有艺术性和明显风格差异，也应保留真实手写感与一定的实际书写可能性。整张画面保持干净、高级、有编辑设计感，不添加 Logo、水印、编号、四角星芒、复杂边框或其他多余装饰元素。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / DRINK]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [PRESS / SCOOP / SMEAR / LAYER / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European café branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the typography and food as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction must visibly change the structure of the letters through believable physics.

Examples: PRESS, food weight compresses and locally deforms the typography; SCOOP, a real scoop removes material directly from a letter, leaving a matching cavity and revealing edible material inside; SMEAR, a knife drags food across the type, causing localized lateral stretching and shear only along the contact zone; LAYER, the typography contains real food layers, and one structural layer is physically pulled out and offset.

Keep the interaction localized, clear, and physically believable, untouched parts of the typography should remain hard, clean, geometric, and readable, use only one main physical mechanism per poster, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, or digital-looking distortion.

Add small editorial information such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], use strong scale contrast rather than traditional menu rows, avoid long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, or template-like layouts.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
真绝了！AI生图居然可以精准控图了！！

现在的生图模型已经越来越厉害了，但一直有个痛点没解决：
没办法精准控图！
因为排版这个东西，真的很难用“提示词”描述清楚，
有时候想修改排版只能反复抽卡！

最近发现模思智能开源的 MOSS-Image，居然真的解决了“修改排版”的问题！！
作为一个用国产算力平台训出来的“纯血国产模型”，效果真的很超预期，
参数只有5B（DiT 主干），支持最长 4K tokens 复杂提示词输入。
最6的是！它支持用 JSON Layout 结构化精准控图！

什么意思呢？
在生图时，可以直接从参数层面指定元素坐标框和方位参数，按照预设的排版，精准生图！
所以，现在商用生图可以用这一套工作流：
MOSS-Image-SFT → 输入布局 JSON → 导入布局 → 检查并拖动位置框 → 保存并应用 → 提交生成。

我拿它做了一张咖啡店的上新海报，然后直接调整 JSON 里的位置框和方位描述，海报上的指定元素就可以更改位置，整体换一种排版！！
做广告海报、电商产品图、社媒封面之类的图，直接可以在提示词里真正把「内容」和「位置」一起交代清楚了。

ONE translucent blue ice block, taller than both characters, has a flat front and jagged top. It rests between and slightly behind them, hiding neither. It stays enormous after shaving.

B's low wooden stand holds one hand-cranked shaver, one white bowl, one plain red-syrup bottle and one spoon. Show these props from the opening. No labels.
The shaver attaches at waist height. Its rear cutter touches the ice; its right-side crank drives the cutter, and its downward chute feeds the bowl. The giant block never shrinks to fit inside the machine.

[Shot 1] Open on a level wide two-shot. <Subject 1> stands screen-left and <Subject 2> screen-right, about three meters apart. Both full bodies are visible and equal in height. B's preparation stand is beside her.
A thrusts one palm toward the empty ground between and slightly behind them. Blue-white frost spreads across the stones, then the single huge ice block rises rapidly from that spot with sharp crystalline growth. Keep both characters unobscured.
From 0.3 to 2.8 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1), using the voice timbre of <Audio 1>, proudly declares, [Japanese] ぜったいれいどの、ちからをみよ! Synchronize her lips and finish before three seconds. Her mouth then closes into a smug smile. By four seconds, the ice has finished growing. Frost mist clears to reveal its solid surface. B calmly looks from the block to the tool on her stand. No frightened reaction.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a medium three-quarter view containing the SAME B, the ice's front surface and all of her preparation stand. A is outside this framing but remains at her established position. B lifts the shaver with both hands and fixes it against the flat ice face, with its chute above the empty bowl. Show contact and a small mechanical fastening click.
B steadies the housing with her left hand and turns the crank smoothly with her right. The score stops at the first turn. Dry, crisp ice-shaving sounds become prominent. [Shot 3] At 00:09.000, cut closer to the SAME B and the bowl resting on the stand. The shaver has stopped and stays attached to the ice. B releases the crank, picks up the syrup bottle with her right hand and squeezes one short red spiral over the white mound. Show liquid leaving the bottle and landing on the ice. She sets the bottle back on the stand before taking the spoon with that hand.

Her mouth closes after the bite and her expression becomes quietly satisfied. No spoken comment, laugh or vocal reaction. The huge magical ice block remains visible behind her as the source of this ordinary dessert.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, hard cut to a frontal close-up of <Subject 1> at her original position. She looks toward B's dessert. Her casting hand remains raised near the edge of the frame. Her smug smile fades, eyes widen, pupils become small and eyebrows lift. Her lips part slightly once, then hold still.

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese sword-action comedy with synchronized sound. Two allied anime heroines defeat a giant in Shibuya, then their victory high-five blows away the city. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face. Use the selected aspect ratio.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1; voice = @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2; voice = @Audio 2.
Giant = @Image 3, approximately 100 meters tall.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. References define identity, not poses or sheet layouts. Exactly one A, one B, one giant. A and B are allies of equal standing height, excluding ornaments.
Heroines retain clean 2D anime linework and cel shading. Giant retains its reference style. Shibuya, buildings, glass, steel, concrete, dust and wet-road reflections are photorealistic. Match lighting and shadows without changing illustrated faces.
VOICE
Exactly ONE spoken line. At 0.3–1.0s, A uses @Audio 1 and says:
「いくよ！」
Natural Japanese pronunciation and accurate lip sync. References define voices, not scripts; never replay recorded words.
B is silent; @Audio 2 is intentionally unused.
After this line, no speech, narration, gasps, screams, grunts, laughter or audible character breaths. Music and effects continue.
LOCATION AND CONTINUITY
Nighttime Shibuya Scramble Crossing after rain: diagonal zebra stripes, station frontage, curved commercial buildings and neon reflections. Screens show abstract colors, no text.
No civilians, traffic or extra enemies.
Early damage is limited to roads and a few facades. Most buildings stand until the high-five.
Heroines occupy the near crossing; giant stands beyond them. The finisher sends it AWAY along the far street.
After landing, A stays screen-left, B screen-right. Keep their arrangement.
Ruins persist; no skyline restoration.
WEAPONS AND HIGH-FIVE
Each heroine carries one katana and one waist scabbard. Both use their right hands in combat.
After the finisher, both visibly sheath their swords BEFORE raising their palms. Swords stay sheathed until the end.
The high-five uses A's LEFT hand and B's RIGHT hand, meeting between them. Other hands stay lowered.
Show separate palms approaching, ONE brief contact, then separation. No fused hands, handshake, fist bump or second contact.
No charging before the high-five; its effect surprises A.
0.0–2.5s — IMMEDIATE ACTION
Low wide opening, already in combat.
The giant swings its fist toward the crossing. B plants her feet and parries with a violet energy barrier along her katana.
Show approach, contact and the fist deflecting upward. Road slabs lift from the force.
A delivers the opening line, then sprints up the giant's lowered forearm as it rises, using it as a moving launch ramp.
Track A upward; keep bodies and blades readable. No flash hiding contact.
2.5–5.0s — FAST TEAMWORK
A springs from the forearm and delivers one airborne diagonal slash. A teal arc visibly strikes the giant's upper torso.
B follows from below with one broad violet slash into its side. The giant recoils after each visible impact.
A drops past the giant's sweeping arm along a clear descending path and lands beside B on the near crossing.
A absorbs the landing with bent knees. Both ready their blades; giant staggers.
Directional tracking, sparks and wind; no floating or overlapping bodies.

5.0–7.5s — COMBINED FINISHER
Low wide view includes both heroines and the giant.
A slashes diagonally upward; B diagonally downward in separate spaces. Physical blades never collide.
Their teal and violet ENERGY arcs cross ahead and fuse into one brilliant crescent.
Show the merger, then crescent contact with the giant's torso. A concentrated forward impact launches its intact body backward above the far rooftops.
Briefly slow contact, then resume speed. The giant lands far down the empty street in heavy dust and stays defeated.
No blood, dismemberment or recovery. Most of the skyline remains standing.
Heroines stay grounded and unharmed.
7.5–9.0s — ORDINARY VICTORY GESTURE
Stable frontal medium-wide two-shot: A left, B right.
Both visibly sheath their katanas, leaving their hands empty.
They turn slightly toward each other, pleased with their teamwork.
A raises her left palm; B her right palm. Show faces, elbows and hands.
Brief pause before contact; reduce the music.
At exactly 9.0s, the palms meet ONCE, clearly visible, with a small dry slap. No flash conceals the contact.
9.0–11.5s — THE HIGH-FIVE BLOWS AWAY SHIBUYA
The shockwave begins at PALM CONTACT, never before it.
A tiny gold-white pulse between their hands expands into a gigantic circular pressure front. Its scale is far larger than the finisher.
Hands separate after the single touch. Both stay planted at the center, hands raised. Hair and clothing react to wind without changing design.
Cut to a high oblique wide view as the ring races outward through Shibuya.
Show a traveling chain reaction: at wave contact, glass bursts, facades shear away, steel frames bend, and huge building sections tear free and fly OUTWARD.
Buildings never simply vanish or break before the ring reaches them. Give debris realistic weight and materials.
The surrounding buildings are blasted away, leaving a broad devastated clearing, rubble and exposed foundations.
Leave an intact crossing patch under the visible, unharmed heroines.
Establish the clearing before the reaction shot. Giant stays defeated; no second blast.
11.5–12.0s — AWKWARD SILENCE
Return to the same frontal two-shot. Ruins match the wide view.
B remains pleased, right hand casually raised, as if the celebration went normally.
A notices the missing buildings. Her smile disappears and her posture freezes.
Dust passes behind them, not across their faces. No vocal reaction.
12.0–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Frontal close-up of A, exact reference face and hair.
Wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows, lips slightly parted ONCE, then held still: her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
A looks toward camera. No blush, crying, shouting or romantic smile.
Short push-in; hold the final full second with tiny natural movement.
Blurred ruined Shibuya and open sky behind her. No restored buildings.
End directly on A, no extra gag or cut back.
SOUND
Instrumental action score; no choir or vocal samples.
Synchronize parry, slashes, landing and giant defeat. Reduce music before the high-five.
At 9.0s: dry palm slap, immediately followed by the video's largest bass pressure impact, then cascading glass, concrete and steel crashes.
No music after the high-five. Final close-up: faint wind and settling debris.
No comedy sting, canned laughter or monster vocals.

EXCLUDE
Text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, extra characters, clones, mixed identities, extra limbs or fingers, fused bodies or hands, morphing swords, costume changes, photorealistic heroine faces, 3D/chibi redesign, injury, gore, flashes hiding contact, premature city destruction or repeated high-fives.

Preserve her exact face, pale green eyes, short black bob, straight bangs, raised patterned hood, oversized black-and-turquoise graphic jacket, shorts, patterned thigh-high socks, chunky boots, and body proportions. Do not redesign her clothing or simplify its graphic motifs.
<Subject 2> is the single pair of red-and-silver headphones worn by <Subject 1> in <Picture 1>. Preserve their exact design. Only ONE pair exists. They are transferred from the girl to the ghost during the video.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second, 9:16 animated comedy. A ghost tries to frighten <Subject 1>. Completely unimpressed, she places <Subject 2> on its head. The ghost immediately starts dancing to the music, forgetting to be scary. She watches with a deadpan expression. Three shots, one location, no dialogue.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in all three shots): fully_preserved - maintain her identity, original costume, hood, hairstyle, and illustrated appearance. Her headphones are removed only during the deliberate transfer.
<Subject 2> (appears in all three shots): fully_preserved - the same headphones move from the girl to the ghost without duplication or design changes.
The character-sheet layout, white background, headings, and multiple views are not part of the video.
detailed_description:
Detailed 2D anime animation matching the reference illustration. Smooth movement, restrained facial acting, and consistent costume details. One quiet Japanese side street at night, with cool blue street lighting and warm light from a nearby shop window. Maintain this location and lighting throughout.

The newly generated ghost is a single pale-blue translucent humanoid with a rounded head, two dark oval eyes, two arms, and a lower body tapering into floating mist. Its head is approximately the same size as the girl's head so the headphones fit. Maintain the same ghost design throughout.
[Shot 1]
A steady, eye-level medium-wide shot. <Subject 1> stands on the left, wearing <Subject 2>, with her face and distinctive jacket clearly visible. On her right, the ghost slowly emerges from the dark background and floats toward her with both arms extended in a spooky pose. It stops beside her, within arm's reach. She turns her eyes toward it and gives it a bored, unimpressed look. She does not flinch or step away. A quiet ominous synth drone accompanies the ghost's approach. No vocal sounds.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a steady medium two-shot showing both heads and the girl's hands.
<Subject 1> calmly turns toward the ghost. With both hands, she grips the earcups of <Subject 2>, lifts the headphones clear of her hood, and places that SAME pair over the ghost's head in one continuous action. Her hood remains raised and unchanged. The ghost stays still during the transfer. She releases the headphones and lowers her hands. The girl is now wearing no headphones; the ghost is wearing the only pair. The ominous drone stops. A bright instrumental dance beat begins as the headphones settle into place.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, cut to a locked medium-wide two-shot, keeping the girl on the left and the ghost on the right.
The ghost immediately starts dancing enthusiastically to the beat. Use one simple repeated movement: head bobbing, shoulders swaying left and right, and bent forearms gently bouncing. Its misty lower body floats in the same position. The headphones remain securely on its head. No spins, acrobatics, or large movements.
<Subject 1> stands still beside it, watching with a completely serious expression. The ghost keeps dancing happily, having forgotten its attempt to frighten her. During the final two seconds, she slowly looks toward the camera and raises one eyebrow slightly. Hold her deadpan reaction while the ghost continues dancing. End at 15 seconds.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet nighttime street ambience, subtle clothing rustle during the transfer, and clear instrumental music from the headphones after they reach the ghost. The music is an upbeat house groove with a steady kick, crisp hi-hats, and playful synth bass. Synchronize the ghost's dance with the beat. No dialogue, narration, singing, whispers, screams, laughter, or vocal reactions.
non_diegetic_music:
A subdued ominous synth drone during Shot 1, ending during Shot 2. No additional score once the headphone music begins.

Exactly one girl, one ghost, and one pair of headphones. Preserve the original clothing graphics. Add no subtitles, captions, title cards, watermarks, or store logos. No duplicated headphones, extra limbs, character morphing, camera shake, additional cuts, or exaggerated facial deformation.

SUBTITLE       = infer_method_subtitle($ TOPIC)         // one-line description

EQUATION_STEPS = infer_equations($ TOPIC, count=5..7)   // ordered derivation chain
STATS          = infer_sidebar_stats($ TOPIC, count=4)  // totals, counts, parameters, memory 
LEGEND         = infer_legend_items($ TOPIC, count=4..6)
METAPHOR       = infer_real_world_metaphor($ TOPIC)     // "assembly line workers", "relay race", "library access"
BOTTOM_PANEL   = infer_bottom_system($ TOPIC)           // the learnable component (queries, attn weights, memory bank)
PALETTE        = infer_academic_palette($ TOPIC)        // light blue background, red connections, slate text

// ── SPATIAL LAYOUT FIELD ───────────────────────────────────────
L(x,y) = panel_weight(TITLE, HERO, METAPHOR, EQUATIONS, LEGEND, BOTTOM)
F = ∇L                    // reading flow: title → hero → derivation → metaphor → bottom
Curl = ∇×L                // layered nesting, curved connection arcs, metaphor loops
Div  = ∇·L                // density of connection lines, arrowheads, callouts

// ── HERO SCHEMATIC (CENTER) ────────────────────────────────────
// A vertical or diagonal stack of translucent blue layers.
LAYER_COUNT = infer_hero_depth($ TOPIC)              // e.g. 93
LAYERS      = for i in 1..LAYER_COUNT:
    layer_shape = translucent_blue_slab(
        thin=true, edges=soft_highlight,
        label=f"Layer {i}" on left margin for key indices
    )
    layer_index = layer_shape in vertical stack with isometric tilt
// Curved red connection arcs sweep from each layer to later layers
for each target layer t:
    for each source layer s in 1..t-1:
        draw_arc(from=s, to=t, color=red, arrowhead, taper=true)
// Also draw base "RAW INPUT" plane at bottom of stack, with arrows rising into all layers.
// Anchors q₁, q₂, ..., qN (pseudo-queries) sit at each layer with small blue cubes.

// ── TITLE BLOCK (TOP-LEFT) ─────────────────────────────────────
TITLE_BLOCK = {
    line_1 : TITLE in bold navy sans,
    line_2 : SUBTITLE smaller gray sans,
    body   : KEY_IDEA in compact paragraph,
    legend : LEGEND with tiny icons,
    callout: "KEY IDEA" boxed note with accent border
}

// ── SIDEBAR STATS (LEFT-MIDDLE) ────────────────────────────────
for each stat in STATS:
    icon  = small pictogram (chip, network, cube, layer)
    label = stat. name
    value = stat.value in large bold
    math  = stat.formula if applicable

// ── EQUATION COLUMN (RIGHT OF HERO) ────────────────────────────
for each step in EQUATION_STEPS:
    rounded_rounded_box with light red border
    contents:
        step_name in small caps bold
        equation in LaTeX-style mono serif
        optional explanatory subline in italic
    connected to the next step by short dashed vertical arrow

// ── METAPHOR PANEL (UPPER-RIGHT) ───────────────────────────────
METAPHOR_PANEL = {
    heading   : "METAPHOR: " + METAPHOR.short_name,
    subhead   : "Building a product (current layer output)",
    panel_A   : "STANDARD RESIDUAL" showing the limited baseline
    panel_B   : METAPHOR. name showing the proposed approach
    figures   : 3–4 small illustrated workers at stations,
                arrows showing material flow, warehouse shelving
}

// ── BOTTOM PANEL (LEARNABLE COMPONENT) ─────────────────────────
BOTTOM_PANEL = {
    heading   : "LEARNABLE " + BOTTOM.system_name,
    q_row     : small rounded pills q₁ q₂ q₃ q₄ ... qN as visual tokens
    body      : short explanatory paragraph
    checklist : "WHAT X LEARNS" with ✓ bullets
    mini_plot : horizontal bar chart of attention weights over sources
    output    : "Context Vector" cube
}

// ── COLOR SYSTEM ───────────────────────────────────────────────
Background   : soft off-white with subtle blue tint
Slabs        : translucent light blue with white highlights
Connections  : deep red arcs with arrowheads
Text         : navy for headers, gray for body
Accents      : amber for KEY IDEA, cyan for pseudo-queries
Baseline fig : grayscale for "standard" comparison

// ── CAMERA & FINISH ────────────────────────────────────────────
Camera       : flat orthographic, no perspective
Resolution   : 8K
Style        : polished academic paper figure, print-ready
Typography   : mixed sans (headers), mono (equations), sans-condensed (labels)
Whitespace   : generous margins between panels; grid-aligned
Post         : none (no grain, no vignette, no drop shadow beyond panel borders)

// ── VALIDATION ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
verify: every equation step logically follows the previous
verify: every stat in sidebar matches the hero schematic
verify: metaphor panel directly parallels the mechanism
verify: text legible at 100% zoom and summary-readable at 25%
verify: no logos, no watermarks, no fake data
Output: one 16:9 8K academic figure poster.

Prompt: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 different decades: INPUT: $ DECADE // Semantic inference ERA_WORD = format_decade_label($ DECADE)              // e.g., "THE 1920s" DIGITS = extract_decade_digits($ DECADE)              // e.g., "1","9","2","0","S" ARTIFACTS = infer_era_artifacts($ DECADE, count=5..8) // objects that define the era SKETCH_MOTIF = infer_technical_sketch_theme($ DECADE)// blueprint / diagram / fashion plate motif PALETTE = infer_era_palette($ DECADE)                 // 1 metallic + 1 dark + 1 cream + accent TAGLINE = infer_era_tagline($ DECADE)                 // 3–6 word optimistic phrase TEXTURE = infer_era_texture($ DECADE)                 // aged paper, canvas, deco line-work  // Build a collage potential field Φ. Φ = digit_weight_field(DIGITS) + artifact_gravity(ARTIFACTS) F = ∇Φ       // composition flow: digits interlock, artifacts orbit Curl = ∇×Φ   // pearl strands, feather curves, smoke swirls, cable runs Div = ∇·F    // density of small details: hatches, dots, engraved lines  // COMPOSITION: // - "THE" small serif caps at top-center. // - Giant decade digits/word center, filling ~70% width. // - Digits rendered as 3D sculpted metallic forms (gold, brass, chrome, neon depending on era). // - Each digit interlocks with a signature artifact: a gramophone, cassette, guitar, moon, etc. // - Decorative strands (pearls, ribbons, cables, film reels) weave through the digits. // - Background: aged paper covered in faint blueprint/technical sketches of era artifacts. // - Tagline: small caps lower-right, 3–6 words, optimistic.  // STYLE: // - Photorealistic collage of shiny metal, dark inlay, cream paper. // - Artifacts rendered as sculptural objects with strong side lighting. // - Background sketches are monochrome line art, faded, low opacity. // - One accent color: pearls, chrome, or neon depending on era. // - Soft studio light from upper-left; long elegant highlights on metallic surfaces. // - No modern gloss, no digital polish, no photorealism of people.  // FINISH: // - Poster reads immediately at thumbnail. // - No extra text besides "THE", the decade, and tagline. // - No logos, no watermarks, no borders. Render 16:9 or 3:2, 8K.

prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Max Prompt

Create a 15-second high-quality Japanese anime comedy video.

Style: polished modern 2D Japanese animation, smooth character animation, clean line art, vivid cel shading, cinematic lighting, expressive but controlled facial animation.
Keep the same visual style, character designs, costumes, faces, hairstyles, body proportions, and room layout throughout the entire video.
Use only two characters:
Character A = the main character.
Character B = the friend holding a vacuum cleaner.

No additional people.
No text.
No subtitles.
No captions.
No logos.
No UI elements.
The entire scene takes place in the same ordinary Japanese living room.
The comedy comes from the contrast between an absurdly powerful anime awakening and an extremely mundane household vacuum cleaner.

[0-5 seconds]
Medium-wide shot.
Character A stands dramatically in the center of the living room.
Character A suddenly begins an exaggerated anime-style awakening.
A huge supernatural aura erupts around Character A:
glowing energy, luminous particles, flowing light, subtle air distortion, clothes and hair gently moving from the energy.
The awakening looks extremely powerful and cinematic, like the climax of a serious battle anime.

Character A has an intense, confident expression and remains almost completely still in a dramatic pose.

Character B stands several meters away, watching calmly with a completely unimpressed expression.

Character B is holding a normal household vacuum cleaner.

Do not transform Character A.
Do not change Character A's clothes, hairstyle, face, or body.
Only the aura becomes dramatically stronger.

[5-10 seconds]

Cut to a slightly closer side angle showing both characters clearly.

Without saying anything, Character B calmly turns on the vacuum cleaner and points the vacuum nozzle toward Character A.
Immediately, the supernatural aura begins getting sucked toward the vacuum nozzle.

Show the effect clearly:

The glowing energy surrounding Character A stretches toward the nozzle.

Luminous particles, smoke-like energy, and flowing light form a visible continuous stream from Character A directly into the vacuum cleaner.

The aura rapidly shrinks around Character A as more and more energy is sucked away.

Character A slowly loses the confident expression and becomes confused.
Character A does not get physically pulled toward the vacuum cleaner.
Only the supernatural aura and energy are sucked into the nozzle.

Character B remains completely calm and casually continues vacuuming.

The vacuum cleaner itself remains visually normal during this shot.

[10-15 seconds]

Cut to a wide static shot.

Character A now stands completely normal with absolutely no aura remaining.

Character A looks silently devastated and confused.

Character B switches off the vacuum cleaner.

A short comedic pause.

Then suddenly:

the vacuum cleaner begins vibrating slightly.

The exact same enormous supernatural aura that previously surrounded Character A now erupts around the vacuum cleaner.

Powerful glowing energy, luminous particles, dramatic light rays, and subtle air distortion surround the ordinary vacuum cleaner as if it has become the strongest character in the anime.

Do not transform the vacuum cleaner into a robot or monster.
Keep it as a completely normal household vacuum cleaner.

Only add the overwhelmingly powerful supernatural aura around it.

Character A and Character B slowly turn their heads and stare silently at the awakened vacuum cleaner.

Hold this final absurd image for the last moment.

End with no dialogue and no explanation.

Important consistency rules:

Only two human characters appear in the entire video.

Keep Character A and Character B visually identical throughout all shots.

Keep the vacuum cleaner identical throughout the video.

The vacuum cleaner must never suck Character A's body, clothes, or hair into the nozzle.

Only the supernatural glowing aura is sucked away.

The energy must visibly travel from Character A into the vacuum nozzle.
Do not make the vacuum cleaner transform.

Do not change locations.

Do not create additional characters.

Do not create duplicate characters.

Avoid excessive camera movement.

Maximum three clear shots.

Prioritize readable visual comedy, stable character consistency, and a strong final punchline.

One arm is wrapped around the horse’s neck, the other is gently held near the bridle/cheek. The pose is very intimate, relaxed and natural, a feeling of trust and true emotional connection. She remains seated in the saddle, with one leg clearly visible along the horse’s flank.  
The hair is very long below the waist and is laid on a round comb, the haircut is a cascade, layered shape, the ends are twisted inwards (there is no comb in the frame) Without waves  
The girl is wearing an all-black minimalistic riding kit: a form-fitting longsleeve, fitted riding leggings and knee-high black leather boots. Slim, toned figure, slim waist. No logos.  
The horse is large, black in color, jet-black shiny coat, thick long black mane, large erect ears, expressive dark eyes. Realistic anatomy. Classic black bridle with metal buckles, black saddle and quilted saddle pad.  
BACKGROUND: A huge open green mountain valley. Lush grass directly under the horse, behind the girl large-scale green mountains with natural folds of slopes and sparse vegetation. Clear saturated blue sky. The landscape is easy to read, WITHOUT artificial heavy blurring.  
light: clear sunny morning, bright natural daylight, NO FLASH. The sun creates natural highlights on black wool, hair and skin, soft but noticeable shadows.  
iPhone 16 Pro rear camera, handheld amateur snapshot, natural imperfect framing, casual travel photo, realistic smartphone perspective, slight phone sharpening, subtle digital grain, natural HDR, vivid colors without excessive processing. Real texture of skin, hair, wool, fabric and leather ammunition. Not a fashion editorial, but the feeling of a real casual iPhone photo.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】  
【主视觉主体】  
【中文核心字】  
【中文标题】  
【英文标题】  
【对角关系】人物跨角 / 斜向负空间 / 自然边界 / 地形切面 / 其他  
【主色】  
【强调色】  
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 **East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Design** 气质的现代竖版海报，核心采用“对角构图”。不要简单把图片或文字旋转 45°，而是先建立一条隐形的斜向主轴，让主体、自然边界、色域或负空间从一个角向另一个角推进，使整个版面的视觉重量产生明确方向。

根据【主题】选择一种最适合的对角机制：人物题材可以让身体动作从左下伸向右上，以姿态本身形成视觉主轴；极简题材可以让大片斜向负空间成为真正主体，只加入极小人物作为尺度参照；自然题材可以利用海岸线、水面、山坡、光影边界等真实斜向关系切分画面；地形或建筑题材可以用大面积切面、尺度差和留白形成距离感。每张只突出一种主要机制，不要把人物、斜线、色块和复杂透视全部叠在一起。

对角构图应依赖“大关系”，不是小装饰。主体或主要色域最好占画面约 45%–65%，同时保留一块明显的安静区域，使画面形成“密到疏”“近到远”或“重到轻”的方向变化。避免平均 50% 对半切，也不要使用标准机械的 45° 斜线，可以让斜向角度略微偏移，使版式更自然、更有编辑感。

Typography 必须保持稳定，与动态画面形成对抗。中文核心字可以放大、贴边、局部裁切，但保持水平或竖直；英文标题使用 Serif、Grotesk 或 Condensed Sans，小信息使用 Neutral Grotesk。不要让所有文字跟随斜线倾斜。建议形成“图像负责动，文字负责稳”的关系，并允许主体与文字产生一处轻微穿插、遮挡或压边。

整体色彩控制在 2–3 个主要层级，以冷白、暖白、黑、灰或单一高纯强调色为主。强调色可以用于短线、节点、局部标题或主体区域，但不要平均散布。保持现代、克制、干净，减少传统装饰和模板化说明文字。信息密度以中等为宜，至少保留约 25%–35% 有效留白。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到强烈的对角大形，第二眼理解主体或边界如何形成方向，第三眼发现尺度、负空间和文字之间的关系，最后再阅读标题与少量信息。整体效果应像真实的现代展览海报、摄影专题、文化视觉或设计年鉴案例，而不是普通图片斜着摆放。

避免：所有元素都倾斜、标准 45° 模板、平均对半切、斜向时间轴、PPT 感、满版说明文字、无意义英文、复杂传统装饰、科技 HUD、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

prompts.text:
Nano Banana 2.1 feels less like image generation and more like art direction.

Prompt

Create a nostalgic, magazine-inspired photo-and-illustration artbook spread using the reference image as the visual foundation. Maintain the original subjects, identities, poses, expressions, wardrobe, framing, and emotional tone without altering their recognizable appearance.

Design the composition as two vertically flowing interpretations of the same moment.

In the upper portion, recreate the reference as an intimate cinematic photograph. Use gentle natural light, realistic skin and fabric textures, muted authentic colors, delicate analog film grain, soft background separation, and shallow depth of field. The image should feel spontaneous and personal, like a quiet memory captured on film rather than a staged portrait.

In the lower portion, reinterpret that identical moment as a raw black-and-white ink drawing printed on warm ivory sketchbook paper. Preserve the characters, pose, proportions, and composition while replacing photographic detail with expressive hand-drawn linework, irregular pen strokes, loose cross-hatching, unfinished contours, and restrained shading. Allow small imperfections so the illustration feels genuinely handmade rather than digitally traced.

Blend both sections naturally so the photograph appears to dissolve into the drawing, creating the impression of a memory gradually becoming an illustration.

Surround the lower artwork with restrained editorial design elements: a small numbered chapter heading, a brief poetic handwritten annotation, tiny archival or documentary notes, and subtle typographic details. Keep all typography secondary to the imagery.

Use generous cream-toned negative space, tactile paper grain, faint printing imperfections, understated vintage publishing details, and an elegant minimalist layout inspired by contemporary photography journals and Japanese visual diaries.

Overall mood: nostalgic, intimate, poetic, cinematic, handcrafted, sophisticated, and emotionally warm.

Maintain realistic anatomy, natural body proportions, recognizable faces, believable hands, and consistent clothing throughout both versions. High-detail editorial finish, cohesive photo-to-sketch transition, no branding, no logos, and no watermark.
